note: Written/formal — everyday anger is 生气. 愤怒 is strong indignation, often at injustice: 感到愤怒 feel outraged · 愤怒地说 (adverbial).
Takes person + verb: 强迫他做某事 force him to do sth · 强迫自己 · 强迫症 OCD. 逼 is blunter and spoken; 迫使 is formal, often with an abstract subject (形势迫使他…).
一时冲动 acted on impulse (fixed) · 别冲动 don't be rash (as adj). Contrast 激动 (excited/moved emotionally, not necessarily rash).
Total annihilation — 消灭敌人/害虫/贫困, stronger than 去掉/除掉. Casually also hyperbole for finishing food: 把这盘菜消灭了 polish off the dish.
Leader out front taking a group along, usually + verb: 带领大家参观 · 带领团队完成任务 · 在他的带领下 under his leadership. 领导 = lead as the boss (and 'the boss' itself).
要面子/爱面子 care about appearances · 给面子 show sb deference · 丢面子/没面子 lose face · 看在我的面子上 for my sake · 面子工程 vanity project.
Formal, assigning blame after the fact: 追究责任 · 追究法律/刑事责任 · 追究…的责任. Negated it stands alone: 这事我就不追究了 I'll let it go.
Slang (informal): 绿茶 also describes a woman who acts sweet/innocent but is calculating — 她很绿茶. Separate from the literal drink.
English 'black tea' = 红茶; 红 names the brewed color, not the leaf. 黑茶 is a different category (fermented dark tea, e.g. 普洱), and 奶茶 is usually built on 红茶.
Physical body only — 身体强壮. Contrast 强大 (powerful, of nations/military/companies) and 坚强 (mentally/emotionally strong, resilient).
Adverb before the verb: 偷偷买了 · 偷偷看一眼 · 偷偷摸摸 sneaky (pejorative). 悄悄 overlaps but leans 'quietly, no noise'; 偷偷 leans 'without letting anyone know'.
Written/official register; speech uses 马上, with 立刻 in between. Lives in orders and notices: 立即执行 · 立即停止 · 立即生效 take effect at once.
VO — 财 is already the object, so it can't take another one (not 理财钱). Say 理财产品 wealth-management product, 学理财 learn money management.
Names the event: 参加跳远 · 跳远运动员 · 立定跳远 standing long jump · 跳远成绩. To say someone jumps far it's 跳得远, not 跳远.
X也好，Y也好 = whether X or Y, it makes no difference (often + 都/随你). After a single clause, …也好 = 'that's fine too / just as well': 他不来也好。
For the size of a change in a percentage, not a share: 增长了五个百分点 (a 5pp rise). Contrast 百分之 for the share itself (占百分之五).
VO, so no second object — 'help the victims' is 救助灾民, not 救灾灾民. Names the relief effort itself: 抗震救灾 · 救灾物资 relief supplies · 参加救灾.
VO and it splits: 炒了十年股 · 炒股炒得很凶. 炒+X is productive: 炒房 flip property · 炒币 crypto · 炒外汇. Say 炒股票, not 炒股股票.
The 儿 gives it a colloquial, Beijing-ish flavor; the neutral written form is just 小偷.
The default term for the language, esp. as skill or subject: 学英语 · 英语水平 · 英语老师 · 英语系. 英文 overlaps freely, and is preferred for text: 英文版, 翻译成英文.
Leans to the language as text or version: 英文版 · 英文名 · 英文资料 · 翻译成英文. It covers speech too (说英文 is normal); 英语 is the default for the subject/skill.
Exit (安全出口 · 出口在左边) and export (出口贸易 · 出口到欧洲). Also 'get the words out': 说不出口 can't bring oneself to say it · 出口伤人.
Affirms an identification emphatically: 这正是我要的 · 你找的正是他 · 正是因为…才… precisely because. More written than 就是; not a substitute for plain 是.
从…的角度(来)看/来说 from the standpoint of… · 换个角度想 look at it another way · 角度问题. Literal too: 拍摄角度 · 45度角.
Beyond the color: 'green/eco' — 绿色食品 · 绿色能源 · 绿色出行. Also 绿色通道 fast track / express lane (hospitals, customs, admissions).
Noun: a formal address — 发表讲话 · 领导讲话 · 重要讲话. Verb: also plain speaking — 别讲话 quiet down · 他不爱讲话 · 讲话算数 be as good as one's word.
Verb and noun: 请求原谅 · 请求支援 ask for backup · 提出请求 make a request · 拒绝请求. Politer and weaker than 要求, which expects compliance.
Written; speech uses 心里 (心里想, 心里难过). Typical frames: 心中充满… · 记在心中 · 心中的英雄 · 埋在心中.
Formal/collective register for traffic and official contexts — 车辆通行, 车辆增多. For an everyday single car, use 车 or 汽车.
Written-leaning; speech prefers 那时候/那会儿. 那时我还小 · 从那时起 from then on · 那时的中国 · 直到那时.
Beyond math: 'amounts to' — 这等于承认失败 · 你这话等于没说 that's saying nothing · 等于白干了 might as well not have bothered.
Emphasizes 'long since', often impatiently: 我早就知道了 · 他早就走了 · 早就该换了 should have swapped it ages ago. Stronger than 已经; usually closes with 了.
Narrative pivot meaning 'just then', not 'right now': 我正要出门，这时电话响了 · 这时，门开了. For the present moment use 现在; speech prefers 这时候.
Colloquial (northern) for 里面: 屋子里头 · 心里头 deep down · 这里头有问题 there's something behind this. 里面 is the neutral default.
Spoken 挺 = quite/pretty, often closed with 的: 挺好的 · 挺贵的 · 挺有意思. Weaker praise than 很好 — 'fine, not bad', not enthusiastic.
Spoken (northern) 那时候: 我们那会儿… · 等他回来那会儿 (future works too). Pairs with 这会儿 'right now'. Keep it out of writing.
Noun only: 市场需求 · 用户需求 · 满足需求 meet a need · 需求量 · 供不应求. 需要 is the verb (我需要…) and does duty as the everyday noun too.
The condition of something, in set pairs: 健康状况 · 经济状况 · 状况良好. Also 出状况 something goes wrong. 情况 is broader (situation, news, what's up).
Noun: reality as against ideals — 面对现实 · 理想与现实 · 现实生活中. Of a person it's an adjective and a jab: 他很现实 = mercenary, calculating.
Written, usually 被称为… or 把X称为Y; 称之为… is the set literary form. Speech just uses 叫(做): 这种茶叫乌龙茶。
Verb + clause: 他主张改革 · 主张用武力解决. Noun: 提出主张 · 一贯主张. Also 自作主张 act without asking. 建议 is the milder suggestion.
News/official register for an unnamed man: 一名男子 · 男子被拘留. Also the sports category: 男子100米 · 男子单打. Speech uses 男的/男人.
Adverbial, normally with a count: 连续三天下雨 · 连续工作十小时 · 连续第五年 · 连续剧 TV serial. 继续 is resuming or carrying on the same action.
Official visit: 出国访问 · 访问中国 · 对…进行访问. IT: 访问网站/数据. An everyday visit is 去看/拜访; a press interview is 采访.
Put a thought or feeling into words: 表达感情 · 表达看法 · 表达能力 · 表达方式. 表示 is the brief token: 表示同意 · 表示感谢 · 表示遗憾.
有/没资格 + verb = (not) in a position to: 你没资格批评我. Also 取消资格 disqualify · 参赛资格 eligibility · 资格证 certificate · 老资格 old hand.
Gather into one point: 集中注意力/精力 · 集中力量 · 集中管理 · 问题集中在… concentrated in. 专心 is the state of being absorbed, not something you do to X.
Written, usually possessive — an entity's own attributes: 自身条件 · 自身利益 · 企业自身的问题 · 自身难保 can't even save oneself. 自己 is the everyday reflexive.
Abstract usage beyond literally unfolding something: 展开调查 carry out an investigation, 展开讨论 hold a discussion — common in news/formal writing.
Works as predicate adjective (他们很团结 they're united) and as verb (团结群众 rally/unite the people, 团结一致 unite as one).
Noun: 行业规范 · 遵守规范. Verb: 规范市场 · 规范用词 bring into line. Adj: 写得很规范 / 不规范 up to standard or not. 标准 is the measurable spec.
确保+clause ensures a condition holds (确保安全). More objective/impersonal than 保证 (promise/guarantee, a personal commitment: 我保证…).
'Non-governmental/folk', the natural antonym of 官方 (official): 民间组织 NGO vs 官方组织, 民间故事 folk tale vs 官方说法 official line.
足够(的)+noun (足够的时间/证据) or 足够+verb phrase: 食物足够吃三天. Predicate: 时间足够了. The negative normally goes to 不够.
Noun: 发表声明 issue a statement · 联合声明. Verb + clause, putting it on record or denying it: 郑重声明 · 特此声明 · 声明与此事无关.
Written; speech uses 等 (等我一下). Takes weighty objects: 等待机会 · 等待结果 · 等待救援 · 耐心等待. Not for a quick 'hang on'.
Verb and noun: 把…组合起来 · 自由组合 · 排列组合 permutations · 组合拳 combination punches. Also entertainment: 男子组合 boy band.
Takes the object directly, no preposition: 配合他 · 配合调查 cooperate with an investigation · 请您配合一下. Also 互相配合 · 默契配合 · 他很配合 he's cooperative.
Physical (站在我背后) but usually loaded: 在背后说坏话 talk behind sb's back · 背后捅刀子 · 背后的原因/真相 what lies behind it.
Bare survival, not quality of life: 生存能力 · 生存空间 · 生存下去 · 适者生存 survival of the fittest. 生活 is living a life — and the noun 'life'.
Attributive or adverbial more than standalone: 集体行动 · 集体辞职 resign en masse · 集体宿舍 · 集体主义. Set against 个人; 团体 is an organized body.
A shift in stance or nature, often gradual, usually intransitive: 观念转变 · 态度转变了 · 转变思路 · 转变为… 改变 is the everyday transitive 'change sth'.
Written/legal: 适用于+X applies to X — 本规定适用于所有员工 · 适用范围 scope · 不适用. 使用 = use something; 适合 = suit someone.
数据/研究/事实表明+clause = the data show that… With a person as subject it's making a stance explicit: 表明态度/立场/决心. 表示 is a brief expression of attitude.
Broader than 实验 (a scientific experiment): also product/field testing, trials — 临床试验 clinical trial, 核试验 nuclear test.
纪录 = the achievement: 世界纪录 · 打破纪录 · 创纪录 · 纪录片 documentary. 记录 = to write down, or the written record (会议记录); the two get mixed in practice.
A serious sit-down, often one you're summoned to: 找他谈话 · 进行谈话 · 谈了很久的话 (it splits). Casual chatting is 聊天.
表面上…，其实… outwardly vs. really · 表面现象 · 做表面功夫 go through the motions. Literal too: 地球表面 · 表面光滑.
Plants and organisms, physical development: 植物生长 · 生长发育 · 生长环境. Also 'be raised in': 他生长在农村. 成长 is a person or career growing up.
Literal stage (登上舞台 · 舞台剧) and just as often an arena of action: 国际舞台 world stage · 政治舞台 · 历史舞台 · 人生舞台.
防止 + what you don't want to happen: 防止事故发生 · 防止感染 · 防止火灾 (a bare noun is fine) · 防止…被误用. 预防 guards against illness; 避免 sidesteps an outcome.
Points back to the outset, usually with regret or contrast: 当初为什么不说 · 当初要是…就好了 · 早知今日，何必当初. 当时 is the neutral 'at that moment'.
Adj: 成绩突出 · 表现突出 · 突出的贡献. Verb: 突出重点 highlight the key points · 突出个性. Literal too: 椎间盘突出 slipped disc.
VO and it splits: 离过婚 · 离了三次婚. The other party takes 跟/和: 跟他离婚 (not 离婚他). Also 离婚率 · 办离婚手续.
Attributive/adverbial: 自主选择 · 自主学习 · 自主创业 · 自主品牌 own-brand · 自主研发. Also 不由自主 involuntarily, in spite of oneself.
Pairs with 一方面: 一方面...，另一方面...(on one hand...on the other). Alone, it can also just mean 'in another respect.'
Resultative 抓(grab)+住(secure) — implies you don't let go. Common figurative object: 抓住机会/重点 seize the opportunity/key point, not just physical grabbing.
= the central region of a larger area (中国中部), not 'between two things' — don't confuse with 中间.
Airing of a program — either subject works: 这部剧周五播出 · 电视台播出了该剧. Also 播出时间 · 首播/重播. 播放 = play a clip; 直播 = broadcast live.
Formal/institutional register — the dependents/family of a specific person (患者家属), used by hospitals, employers, the military. 家人 is the everyday word.
Ahead in a ranking or score: 领先对手 / 领先于对手 · 领先两分 lead by two · 遥遥领先 far out front · 领先地位 · 世界领先水平.
Sits straight before a noun or verb, no 地: 初步方案 · 初步了解 · 初步确定 · 据初步统计. Rarely a predicate — say 只是初步的 rather than 很初步.
Pairs with 另一方面 (or 又) for 'on one hand...on the other': 一方面...，另一方面...。Also fine used alone.
Stronger/more formal than 喜欢 — object is usually a cause, country, career, or activity (热爱祖国/工作), not used for romantic love of a person.
Describes an atmosphere/event (热烈欢迎/鼓掌) — vigorous and enthusiastic. Contrast 热情, which describes a person's own warmth/hospitality.
= go meet an arriving person (去机场迎接), or metaphorically 'gear up for' (迎接挑战). Contrast 欢迎, the verbal/attitude 'welcome' (欢迎光临).
The social setting: 正式场合 · 公开场合 in public · 社交场合 · 在这种场合下 · 说话要分场合 read the room. 场所 is a physical venue (公共场所).
Doing it without being told: 他很自觉 · 自觉排队 · 自觉遵守规定. Also 'conscious(ly)': 自觉性 · 不自觉地 without meaning to.
Noun: 经受考验 withstand a test · 严峻的考验 · 对…的考验. Verb: 这件事很考验耐心 tests your patience. Not an exam — that's 考试.
有头脑 shrewd · 头脑清醒 clear-headed · 头脑发热 get carried away · 头脑风暴 brainstorm. The thinking faculty, not the physical head (头).
= ordinary/common folk, as opposed to officials or elites — more colloquial than the formal/political 人民 or 群众.
= degree of difficulty, paired with 大/高/低: 难度很大/有难度. Not 'a difficulty' (that's 困难).
(written/festive) shared, festive joy (欢乐的气氛). 快乐 is the everyday word for personal happiness.
Noun = an aspiration or a declared choice: 从小的志愿 · 填(报)志愿 pick your university choices. The compounds carry the load: 志愿者 volunteer · 志愿服务.
Often in set phrases: 忐忑不安 (anxious), 坐立不安 (unable to sit still), 心神不安 (unsettled) — beyond plain predicate use (很不安).
Adverbial before the verb, no 地: 他整天玩游戏 — often carries a complaining tone, like 'all day long' said with exasperation.
Also a test/exercise question (这道题目 = this problem on a test), not just an essay 'title' — same word covers both.
(formal/political register) the Chinese nation as a civilizational whole — official/patriotic contexts, not casual talk about 中国人.
Describes how something is expressed — writing, imagery, a talk (生动的描写) — not a person's own personality (that's 活泼).
Presentational: source + 传来 + the sound/news — 厨房里传来香味 · 远处传来歌声 · 前方传来消息. What arrives sits after the verb; no agent does the sending.
Rush there and make it: 赶到现场 · 赶到车站 · 及时赶到 arrive in time. Destination attaches directly. Compare 赶回家 · 赶上末班车 catch the last bus.
Precedes a number/quantity only: 将近两个小时/将近一半. Contrast 几乎, which modifies verbs/adjectives (几乎忘了) — 将近 doesn't work there.
An impression from how something looks: 她看上去有点累 · 看上去不像坏人 · 看上去很新. ≈看起来, which also covers non-visual inference; 看着 does the same in speech.
(written) = 变成, formal register for transformation (逐渐变为公园). Use 变成 in speech.
Intensifier suffix after an adjective: Adj + 极了 = extremely Adj (热极了, 好极了) — sentence-final, can't precede the adjective like 很/非常 do.
Of manner — warm and approachable: 态度亲切 · 亲切地问候 · 亲切交谈. Also the feeling of familiarity: 听到乡音感到很亲切. 亲密 = close/intimate between people.
Colloquial for ability, almost always as 有本事 — more casual than 能力/本领, sometimes sarcastic (有本事你就... 'if you're so capable, then...').
suǒcháng = one's strong suit: 发挥所长 · 各有所长 · 用人之所长. Same characters, different word: suǒzhǎng, head of an institute or police station (派出所所长).
Verb-object, splits: 吵了一架. Takes the other party with 跟/和, not as a direct object: 跟他吵架 (not 吵架他).
= the whole venue/audience (全场观众起立) or an entire match's duration (全场发挥出色) — not 'the whole scene' in a story.
Lives in 天气预报; as a bare verb it's technical (预报明天有雨). Don't mix it with 预告 = advance notice, trailer (电影预告片).
Besides 'cola,' 可乐 is colloquial for 'funny/amusing': 这事真可乐 (that's hilarious) — context tells you which.
Fixed: 有的是 + noun = there's no shortage of, said confidently or dismissively — 有的是时间/钱/机会 · 这种人有的是. Don't read 有的 as 'some'.
Humble register: 向某人请教(某事) — 向老师请教问题 · 请教您一个问题 may I ask you something · 不懂就要请教. More deferential than plain 问.
Spoken (= 干嘛). Two jobs: 'doing what' — 你在干吗？ and 'why on earth' — 你干吗不早说？ Sentence-final it challenges the point of an act: 跑过来干吗？
Two readings: jiēshi = sturdy (身体/桌子很结实) · jiē shí = to bear fruit (树结实了).
Homophone of 功夫: 工夫 = time/effort spent (花工夫, 有工夫 = have free time); 功夫 is skill/martial arts. Easy to mix up in writing.
Someone's strong suit: 发挥长处 · 学习别人的长处 · 各有长处. Pairs with 短处 (取长补短). 优点 is the everyday 'good point' about a person.
Foreign-language text: 外文书 · 外文资料 · 外文网站 · 外文翻译. 外语 is the general word, and the one for ability and study: 外语水平 · 外语系 · 学外语.
Spoken (northern): 有空儿吗？· 没空儿 · 抽空儿 make time · 一有空儿就… Non-r 空(kòng) is the neutral form; 有时间 works everywhere.
Describes an immediate reaction in narration (他连忙起身). Unlike 赶紧/赶快, it can't be used as a command (不能说'你连忙做').
Someone's weak point: 每个人都有短处 · 别拿别人的短处开玩笑. Pairs with 长处. 缺点 is the everyday flaw; 弱点 the exploitable weakness.
Unheated water, opposite of 热水/开水: 用凉水洗脸 · 喝凉水. 冰水 is iced. 凉白开 = boiled water left to cool, the usual thing to drink at home.
针对+issue or person, then the action: 针对这个问题提出建议 · 针对性强 well-targeted. In speech it can mean singling sb out: 我不是针对你 not getting at you.
Organized combat: 战斗场面 · 参加战斗 · 战斗力 fighting strength · 战斗到底. A scuffle is 打架; a political or ideological struggle is 斗争.
Uphold what's under threat: 维护权益 · 维护秩序 · 维护形象 · 维护稳定. Also technical upkeep: 系统维护中 under maintenance. 维修 = repair something broken.
据统计，… 'according to the figures', the standard news opener before a number. Verb: 统计人数 tally up · 统计数据 · 统计学 statistics (the field).
Verb: 设置密码 · 设置路障 · 设置障碍 put obstacles in sb's way. Also the noun for a device's Settings: 打开设置 · 恢复默认设置. 设施 = facilities.
(written) always takes a serious situation/challenge as object (面临压力/困境) — can't take a person, unlike 面对 (面对朋友).
Noun: 保守秘密 keep a secret · 说出秘密. Attributive/adverbial 'secret(ly)': 秘密武器 · 秘密进行 · 秘密会见. 神秘 = mysterious in feel.
Object is a situation/action to prevent (避免误会/冲突), not a physical thing or person you dodge — for that use 躲避/避开.
More formal than 特别, and unlike 特别 can't mean 'especially' (adverb) — 特殊 is only an adjective: 特殊情况/特殊待遇.
Verb and noun both: 他移民了 · 新移民 · 移民局 · 移民政策. As a verb the destination attaches straight on: 移民加拿大 (or 移民到加拿大).
Informal, affectionate for wife. 妻子 neutral · 太太 polite · 夫人 formal. Distinct from 老婆婆 (old woman).
Noun only: 公共设施 · 基础设施 infrastructure · 设施齐全 fully equipped · 配套设施. 设置 is the verb 'set up'.
Also attributive for 'mobile': 移动电话/移动支付 (mobile phone/payment). As a verb, more formal/general than 搬 (move furniture).
Written 'rapid', mostly adverbial: 迅速发展 · 迅速反应 · 迅速离开 · 反应迅速. Physical action is fine too; plain 快 is the spoken word.
Staple grain collectively — rice, wheat, corn: 粮食产量 · 节约粮食 · 粮食安全 food security. Food in general is 食物; a cooked meal is 饭.
Keep going something that might otherwise fail: 维持秩序 · 维持现状 · 维持生计 make ends meet · 勉强维持. 保持 is the neutral 'keep' (保持联系/安静).
(written/formal) 'good' in official or descriptive contexts (良好的习惯, 状态良好) — casual speech uses plain 好.
Common pattern 有/呈…趋势 = show a trend of... (呈上升趋势 = a rising trend).
Import: 进口商品 · 进口车 imported car · 进口税 · 从日本进口. Pairs with 出口 in 进出口贸易. The 'entrance' sense has mostly gone to 入口.

Pattern: 阻止 + person + VP = stop someone from doing something (阻止他玩游戏) — no equivalent of 'from' needed.

Takes abstract goals (追求梦想/真理) — also specifically means to romantically pursue/court someone (他在追求她).
几户人家 = household (rénjiā). As a pronoun it's rénjia: 人家怎么想 other people · 人家帮了你 he/she did · coy self-reference 人家不要嘛.

Business/economic register for supplying goods/resources at scale (供应链, 供应充足) — for providing help/info in general, use 提供.
Mostly the noun 'device/apparatus' (安全装置). For the verb 'to install,' 安装 is far more common.
Two slots: before a verb, many actors in quick succession (大家纷纷发言 · 纷纷表示); after a noun, things coming thick and fast (大雪纷纷 · 议论纷纷).
Noun: a scholarly or literary work — 一部著作 · 学术著作 · 著作权 copyright · 著作等身 prolific. The verb 'author' is 撰写 or 著.
Written; the text does the recording: 史书记载… · 日记里记载了… · 据记载 according to the records. Also a noun: 有明确的记载.
More evocative/heroic register than plain 士兵 — also metaphorical for anyone fighting hard for a cause (白衣战士 = medical workers).
The intensity of a contest or clash: 激烈的竞争/争论/战斗 · 竞争得很激烈 · 反应激烈. 剧烈 is bodily/physical intensity: 剧烈运动/疼痛.
Before the verb, mostly in requests: 请尽快回复 · 尽快处理/安排 · 尽快给我答复. Asks for speed politely; 赶快/赶紧 is 'hurry up now'.
An aura of mystery, not a specific secret: 神秘的客人 · 神秘感 · 神秘兮兮 acting all mysterious. A concrete secret is 秘密.
(clinical/formal) for everyday 'medicine' use plain 药 (吃药, not 吃药物) — 药物 fits doctor's language, drug names, pharmacology.
More literary/vivid than 颜色 — often figurative for 'overtones': 政治色彩 (political overtones), 地方色彩 (local flavor).
Noun = a lesson paid for with a mistake: 吸取教训 learn from it · 给他一个教训. Verb = to dress someone down: 教训他一顿, never neutral 'teach'.
Fixed formal word, 被+迫 fused — goes directly before the verb: 被迫取消/离开, no separate agent needed like normal 被 sentences.
Staggered timing — arriving/happening one after another over time (客人陆续到达). Contrast 纷纷, many people acting alike almost at once.
(formal) guiding someone's thinking/behavior indirectly (引导学生思考). Contrast 带领 (physically lead a group) and 领导 (organizational leadership).
Technical/medical register for testing/detecting something specific (检测血糖/设备) — more lab/instrument-oriented than general 检查.
Implies a deliberate, staged process (逐步实现/推进). Contrast 逐渐, gradual/natural change over time without planned steps.
(formal/agricultural) — for casual gardening, plain 种 is more common (种花/种菜); 种植 fits farming contexts (种植面积).
(formal, organizational) a broad guiding direction (发展方针) — more strategic/general than 政策, a specific concrete policy.
Affectionate, not just literal infant — also a cutesy pet name for a romantic partner or even a pet in casual speech.
Break free of something clinging to you: 摆脱贫困/困境/压力/坏习惯 · 摆脱他的跟踪 shake off. Throwing an object away is 扔掉.
Second-clause connector: 快走，不然赶不上了 = otherwise…. 不然/要不然/否则 are the same move; 要不然 also softens into a suggestion: 要不然明天去吧.
Formal. Passive is commonest — 被列为文物保护单位 — but active works too: 把/将它列为重点. What follows is a category or rank.
Dispute over an issue: 争论不休 argue endlessly · 争论的焦点 · 一场激烈的争论. More intellectual than 吵架, less organized than 辩论.
Attributive only: 小型企业/小型车/小型会议. Doesn't take 很 or stand as the predicate — 'it's small' is 很小. Names a size class, not appearance.
Describes a person's naivety/purity of character (性格单纯), or as adverb 'merely' (单纯为了钱) — not task simplicity, which is 简单.
= a specific method/trick for doing something well (切洋葱的技巧). Contrast 技能, a broader learned competency (a job skill).
A complaint aimed at an authority: 向平台投诉 · 投诉这家店 · 接到投诉/投诉电话 (also a noun). Grumbling that seeks no redress is 抱怨.
A shop/business being open and operating (营业中, 营业时间 = business hours). Contrast 经营, which means to run/manage the business.
Covers both literal inheritance (继承遗产) and cultural heritage (世界遗产 = World Heritage Site) — same word for both.
Covers physical nausea and 'gross/disgusting.' Colloquially also a verb meaning to needle/annoy someone on purpose (他就是想恶心你).
Written/formal for 朋友, plus the app sense: 加好友 add · 好友列表 · 微信好友 · 生前好友. In speech 'best friend' is 最好的朋友.
(formal/abstract) contrast the everyday 个人 (a person). Also the root of 个体户 (self-employed sole proprietor).
Something runs on in time: 传统延续至今 · 延续了三天 · 延续生命/香火 keep going. It never takes a verb — 'continue doing' is 继续 + verb.
Going to look firsthand: 实地考察 · 去工厂考察 · 考察团. Also sizing a person up over time: 考察干部. 调查 can be done from a desk.
Servicing machines and buildings: 维修机器 · 维修工/维修站 · 免费维修. ≈修理 but more professional; 维护 is routine upkeep (设备维护).
≈逐渐 but more colloquial, and usually with a directional result: 天渐渐暗下来 · 渐渐热起来 · 渐渐地就习惯了.
Financial/business register for returns or gains (投资收益). Contrast 收入, the general word for income/earnings (工资收入).
Cantonese loanword. The mainland everyday bus is 公交车; 巴士 lives on in 大巴 coach · 中巴/小巴 minibus · 双层巴士, and in HK/Taiwan speech.
Fraction marker: [denominator]分之[numerator] = numerator/denominator, e.g. 三分之一 = 1/3, 百分之五十 = 50%. Order is reversed from English.
Usually the adjective 'conservative' (保守估计). Also a verb meaning to keep/guard: 保守秘密 (keep a secret) — an entirely different sense.
Nearly always negated: 不要轻易放弃 · 不轻易相信别人 · 不能轻易下结论 = not lightly, not without good reason. Plain 'easily' is 容易/轻松.
Also figurative in modern usage: 票房神话 (a box-office legend), 神话破灭 (the myth is shattered) — not just ancient mythology.
Youth as a life stage, faintly literary: 贡献青春 · 青春年华 · 青春期 puberty · 青春痘 pimples. Calling someone young is 年轻.
Object is a stretch of time: 度过假期/童年/愉快的一天 — more formal than 过暑假. Hardship conventionally takes 渡: 渡过难关. Money takes 花.
≈代替. 替代 is the formal/technical one: 替代品 substitute · 替代方案 · 替代能源 · 不可替代 irreplaceable. 代替 is the everyday verb: 我代替他去.
The peak point: 电影的高潮 · 歌的高潮部分 the hook · 掀起…高潮 set off a wave of. It is also the sexual sense, so context carries it.
Sealing off an area/system entirely (道路封闭, 封闭式管理) — more total/systemic than 关闭, which closes a specific door/shop/device.
A written mark: 标点符号 · 数学符号 · 货币符号. 'X stands for Y' is the verb 象征 (鸽子象征和平); 文化符号 = cultural icon.
Technical/scientific register (构造非常坚固, 地质构造). The everyday, more general word for 'structure' is 结构.
Common in instructions to physically gather at a point (到大厅集合) — also the math term for 'a set.' Contrast 聚集, natural congregating (人群聚集).
Structured, often competitive debate (辩论赛) — more formal/organized than 争论 (a heated dispute) or 吵架 (a personal quarrel).
Needs a verb: 流眼泪/流下眼泪 shed · 掉眼泪 (colloquial) · 忍住眼泪 hold back · 擦眼泪 wipe away. 'To cry' itself is 哭.
Literary/artistic description — how a writer depicts a scene (描写秋天的美景). Contrast 描述 (neutral, factual) and 形容 (describe qualities with adjectives).
Written, for measurable change: 显著提高/下降 · 显著差异 · 成效显著 · 显著改善. 明显 is the everyday 'obvious' (很明显).
Takes its object directly: 战胜对手/困难/恐惧/自己. Unlike 打败 (beat a person or team), it also works on abstract enemies.
Closer to voting in favor of a proposal (赞成这个建议) than general agreement. For agreeing to a fact, request, or plan, 同意 is the more neutral default.
Adverb, written-leaning: 独自一人前往 · 独自生活/旅行/承担. 单独 = separately, on its own (单独谈谈), with no lonely overtone.
For abstract ties between things — 紧密合作/紧密联系 — not personal warmth between people (that's 亲密).
Verb-object (破+产), so no object: 公司破产了 · 宣布破产 · 面临破产 · 使…破产. Figurative too: 计划破产 the plan fell through.
Usually a noun for the shape/styling itself (发型造型, 人物造型) — 做造型 = get styled/get a hairdo, not literally 'mold' something.
A doubt about something: 对…有疑问 · 毫无疑问 without a doubt · 疑问句 interrogative. A question you ask out loud is 问题 (提问/问问题).
A named historical period (post-1840 Qing into the Republic), not just 'recent': 近代史 · 近代化 · 近代文学. Today's 'modern' is 现代/当代.
Tech collocations: 语音输入/语音识别/发语音 = voice input/recognition/send a voice message. For one word's pronunciation use 发音, not 语音.
Object direct or with 对: 不在乎钱 · 不在乎别人怎么看 · 对…完全不在乎 · 满不在乎 blasé. 不介意 = don't mind, politer.
Takes a list-like object: 列入计划/名单/范围 = get included on/in a plan, list, scope — always something categorical, not a physical item.
Beyond literal conquest, used for winning someone over completely: 征服观众/征服她的心. More total/dramatic than 战胜 (overcome/defeat).
R&D of a technical product — 研制新药/新型号 — narrower than 开发, which also covers software, land, markets etc.
Person and field alike: 她是会计 · 学会计 · 会计专业. 会计师 = certified accountant; the finance function/department is 财务.
Energy for effort, not muscle (力气): 精力充沛 full of energy · 集中精力 concentrate · 花精力 put effort in · 精力有限.
State and change of state both: 头脑清醒 clear-headed · 保持清醒 stay lucid · 清醒过来 come to / sober up · 还没清醒.
Written adverb, always before a verb: 率先提出/率先实现/率先推出 = be the first to do it. Not a predicate on its own.

Indirect, implicit suggestion (through tone, gesture, wording) — contrast 提示, an explicit hint/reminder. Also a noun: 给他一个暗示.
The meaning carried inside a word, symbol or act: 这个字的含义 · 深刻的含义 · 含义丰富. 意思 is the everyday word; significance is 意义.

Eases a problem, not a person: 缓解压力/疼痛/疲劳/交通拥堵. Also intransitive — the problem itself lets up: 病情缓解了.

Formal and weighty: 抓住机遇 seize it · 面临机遇 · 机遇与挑战 · 历史机遇. An everyday chance to do something is 机会 (有机会去).

External rules of a group/organization (遵守纪律, 违反纪律) — not personal willpower, which is 自律.

Vivid, sharply distinct qualities — 鲜明的对比/特点/立场 — not physical brightness of light (明亮).

Shrinks a size or scope: 缩小图片 · 缩小范围/差距/规模. 缩短 is for length and duration (缩短时间).
Personal relationships/feelings — 亲密关系/朋友. Contrast 紧密, for abstract ties like cooperation between organizations.
(formal) Abstract virtue in business/social contexts — 诚信经营, 诚信问题. For a person's day-to-day honesty, use 诚实.

Two distinct uses: 布置房间 (decorate/arrange a room) and 布置作业/任务 (assign homework/a task) — same verb, different domains.

For something in the past that's gone — 怀念当年/家乡 — 想念 is for missing a person you're apart from but could reunite with.
Blunt/informal, can be rude as a direct address — unlike the neutral descriptive 他很胖.

Weight that presses down: 沉重的负担/压力/心情/打击 · 脚步沉重. Literal loads take it too (沉重的行李), but speech usually just says 很重.

Colloquial/spoken — 美元 is the more official term for the same currency, used in banking and news.
Verb: 节省时间/开支/成本. Also an adjective for a thrifty person: 他很节省 (≈节俭). 节约 leans public resources: 节约用水/能源.
(formal) States a blanket rule with no exceptions — 一律打八折/一律不准 — common in notices and regulations.
着 = zháo, the result reached: 睡着了 dropped off · 睡不着 can't get to sleep · 好不容易才睡着. Read shuìzhe it means lying asleep instead.
(formal/legal) Financial or legal guarantee with liability — 为…担保, 担保贷款 — for a general promise use 保证 instead.
Literal bone. Figurative: 硬骨头 an unbending person, or a tough job (啃硬骨头) · 软骨头 a spineless one · 骨子里 deep down.
Interior renovation/fit-out of a home or office (装修新家) — for fixing something broken use 修理, for structural rebuilding use 改造.
Raw cognitive ability/IQ (智力测试, 智力发展) — not the deeper 智慧 (wisdom) or the adjective 聪明 (smart).
Literal shadow. Figurative traces: 连影子都没有 not a trace of it · 有他父亲的影子 you can see his father in him.
Repetition that has gone on too long: 一再迟到/拒绝/推迟 — though also neutral 一再强调. 再三 is deliberate repetition: 再三考虑.
Both intransitive (他动摇了 = he wavered) and transitive (动摇军心 = shake sb's resolve). Often negated to praise resolve: 没有动摇.
Altruistic enthusiasm — helping others, public causes: 热心公益/热心帮助邻居. Contrast 热情, interpersonal warmth/hospitality.
General praise from anyone (称赞他的作文) — 表扬 is specifically praise from an authority figure (teacher/boss) as formal recognition.
Specifically businesses/shops shutting down (银行/公司倒闭). Near-synonym of 破产, but 倒闭 emphasizes closing operations, not insolvency itself.
(formal) Object is always something sought from others — 征求意见/征求同意 — never a physical object.
Implies actively pushing a sale, often unwanted — 向我们推销保险 — the neutral 'to sell' in general is 销售/卖.
Mostly a noun, but usable as a weather verb: 打雷闪电 · 又打雷又闪电. Figurative speed: 闪电般的速度 · 闪电式访问 · 闪电战 blitz.
Talking about someone or something, often judgmental: 议论纷纷 abuzz with talk · 别在背后议论人 · 引起议论. 讨论 works toward a decision.
How strongly you want or need something: 迫切希望/迫切需要 · 迫切的心情/需求/问题. An urgent situation itself is 紧急 (紧急情况).
Mainly attributive, meaning 'digital' — 数码相机/产品. For 'a digit/number' by itself use 数字, not 数码.
Written, for heroic acts: 英勇作战 · 英勇牺牲 die a hero's death · 英勇事迹. Everyday 'brave' — a person, a choice — is 勇敢.
Land as opposed to sea/water (陆地 vs 海洋) — not land as property/territory, which is 土地.
Also used beyond food for bundled service plans: 手机套餐/流量套餐 = phone/data plan.
The everyday spoken word; signs use 吸烟 (禁止吸烟). Separable: 抽根烟 have a smoke · 抽了一支烟 · 烟抽得很凶 smokes heavily.

Verb-object (延+期) — no direct object noun. To delay a specific event, 把X延期/推迟; bare 延期 attaches to a time span: 延期两周.
(formal) Describes an outcome/event as fully successful, no hitches — 圆满成功/结束 — not used for a person's character.
For reserving a room, ticket, or table (预订酒店/机票) — for scheduling an appointment/service (doctor, haircut) use 预约 instead.
Formal/written register — signage and health language: 禁止吸烟 no smoking · 吸烟有害健康. Everyday speech is 抽烟 (抽根烟 have a smoke).
Literary. Tranquility as atmosphere or inner state: 宁静的夜晚 · 内心宁静 · 宁静致远. 安静 is the plain 'no noise' word (请安静一点).
Verb 讲究+N = be particular about (讲究卫生/穿着/礼节). Adj = tasteful, well-appointed (装修得很讲究). Noun: 这里面有讲究 there's a right way to it.
Depth built up over time, abstract: 深厚的友谊/感情 · 深厚的基础/功底 solid grounding. Physical depth is just 深 (水很深).
Conveying regards, often at a distance or through someone: 代我问候你父母 · 问候一声 · 节日问候. Greeting someone in person is 打招呼.
Erudition a person has accumulated: 很有学问 learned · 做学问 do scholarship. Also 这里面有学问 = there's real subtlety to it. 知识 is plain facts.
Moral loftiness, and it sounds ceremonial: 品德高尚 · 高尚的情操/品格. For a decent friend you'd just say 人很好; social rank is 地位高.
Transitive — the dream content follows directly: 梦见你 · 梦见自己回老家. 做梦 is verb-object and can't take it. 梦到 is the everyday equivalent.
The sentence is a false hit: 今天+真漂亮. 天真 = childlike innocence (天真可爱) or a dig at naivety (你太天真了). 幼稚 is always an insult.
Written admiration voiced from a judging position: 大加赞赏 · 对…表示赞赏 · 赞赏的目光. 赞成 (agree to a proposal) is a different word.
Thoroughness in how work is done: 做事细致 · 细致的分析 · 细致入微. 细心 is the person's attentiveness; a finely made object is 精致.
Adverb before the unavoidable outcome: 难免会紧张 · 难免有失误 · 难免要走弯路. 免不了 is the spoken twin; 在所难免 the set formal phrase.
Within the family, specifically the eldest sister. Addressing a stranger it reads as middle-aged — for a younger woman speakers now say 美女 or 姐.
With an object, no 来: 停下脚步 · 停下手里的活. Intransitive, add 来: 跑了很久才停下来. 停下来+V = pause in order to do sth.
X离不开Y = X can't do without Y: 生活离不开手机 · 成功离不开努力. Potential form of 离开, so the affirmative is 离得开.
Institutional/written: 秋季学期 fall semester · 秋季运动会 · 秋季新品. Talking about the season itself in speech, 秋天.
Beyond 'silently' — unnoticed and unrewarded, usually admiring: 默默付出 · 默默地支持 · 默默无闻 unsung. Merely not talking is 不说话/沉默.
Bound to compounds: 百货商场/百货公司 department store · 百货大楼 · 日用百货 daily goods (store signage). Never stands alone for 'goods'.
Mostly 打招呼 = say hi, or give a heads-up (走之前打个招呼). Bare verb 招呼 = attend to, call over: 招呼客人 · 招呼大家过来.
Caring for something so it isn't damaged, usually shared or weaker things: 爱护公物 · 爱护环境 · 爱护身体. 爱惜 is not wasting (爱惜时间/粮食).
Physical solidity of structures: 坚固的桥梁/城墙/房子. A person's resilience is 坚强; a firm bond or foundation is 牢固 (基础牢固).
The sentence is a false hit: 一片+面包. 片面 = one-sided, always critical: 片面的看法 · 你太片面了 · 片面追求分数. Opposite 全面.
Modifies a noun directly: 长途汽车 coach · 长途电话 · 长途旅行/跋涉. Never a predicate — a long haul is 路很远, not 很长途.
The tax-registered invoice used for reimbursement: 开发票 issue one · 要发票吗 · 报销要发票. A plain shop receipt is 收据/小票.
Beyond pulling open (拉开窗帘/抽屉): 拉开距离/差距 widen a gap · 拉开序幕 raise the curtain on, kick off.
Three uses: generous (对朋友很大方) · poised, unselfconscious (举止大方 · 大方点儿!) · of clothes/design, understated and tasteful (颜色很大方).
Verb-object, so no mountain can follow it. Name one and 山 drops: 登泰山 · 爬那座山. 登山 alone = go climbing: 登山鞋 · 登山队.
Colloquial, straight before the verb: 使劲推/喊/拽. Separable: 使把劲儿! · 使了半天劲. Not transitive — 使劲推门, never 使劲门.
Visiting to show care — the sick, elderly, family: 看望病人 · 看望老人. 拜访 is a respectful or business call; in speech, 去看看奶奶.
Two poles: doing something to the full — 玩得痛快 · 喝个痛快; and being decisive, no hedging — 他答应得很痛快 · 痛快点儿! · 痛快招供.
Modifies a verb to mean 'in passing, without extra effort' — 随手关门/关灯/扔垃圾.
You relay someone else's message: 请转告他明天开会 · 我一定转告 · 帮我转告一声. The person is the object, the message follows.
Winning by draw, not by skill: 中了大奖 · 中了一等奖 (separable). Winning a match is 赢; taking an award is 得奖/获奖.
Socializing as a skill: 交际能力 · 善于交际 · 交际圈. 社交 is the modern general word (社交媒体/社交场合); 交际 lives mostly in these set phrases.
Vast expanse, written: 宽广的草原/天地 · 胸怀宽广 broad-minded. A wide road or river is 宽阔; plain width is 宽 (路很宽).
Holding or entering the draw itself: 抽奖活动 · 参加抽奖 · 抽中了一等奖. Actually winning it is 中奖.
Mainland usually drops the 儿: 模特. 当模特/做模特 work as a model · 平面模特 print model · 名模 supermodel.
Separable: 转个弯 · 在路口右转弯 (or just 右转). Figurative: 脑子一时转不过弯来 = can't adjust to a new way of thinking.
Affectionate for kids' mischief: 这孩子真调皮 · 调皮捣蛋. 淘气 is its everyday twin; genuinely bad behavior is 不听话.
Adverb for insistent, deliberate repetition: 再三叮嘱/强调/考虑/挽留. 一再 overlaps and also covers unwanted repeats (一再犯错).
The physical document: 录取通知书 acceptance letter · 入学通知书 · 中奖通知书. A spoken or posted notice is just 通知.
Northern colloquial for 后面: 站在你后头 · 排在后头. Also time — 后头再说 later · 后头还有呢 there's more coming.
看不起 despise ↔ 看得起 hold in regard (谢谢你看得起我). 瞧不起 is the colloquial twin. Different from 看不上 = deem not good enough.
Hospital department, paired with 外科 (surgery): 挂内科 · 看内科 · 内科医生. The split is non-surgical vs surgical, not inside vs outside the body.
Northern spoken 味道 — covers taste and smell alike: 味儿太咸 · 有股怪味儿. Also atmosphere: 年味儿 the feel of New Year · 有点儿京味儿.
Idiom: 有两把刷子 = to have real skill/be good at something (lit. 'have two brushes').
Contact-hour unit for a course: 一共五十个学时 · 每周四学时. One 学时 is a class period, usually 45–50 min, not a clock 小时.
Erhua spoken form. Brand-name goods: 穿名牌儿 · 一身名牌. Plain 名牌 also = top-tier (名牌大学) and a name tag/plate (桌上的名牌).
Northern colloquial. Of a person, strength: 胳膊真有劲儿. Of an activity, fun: 这游戏玩起来有劲儿. The negative 没劲儿 (boring; worn out) is commoner.
Also a common tech-context verb: 编辑文档/照片 = edit a document/photo — not just the job title.
Economics: 资本主义 · 资本市场 · 民间资本. Figurative: X的资本 = what gives you standing to X — 骄傲的资本 · 炫耀的资本. Money you put in is 资金.
Long-horizon blueprint: 城市规划 · 五年规划 · 职业规划 career plan (personal use is normal). 计划 is the concrete plan you execute now.
Noun = the comment/review itself: 评论区 comment section · 一条评论. Verb: 评论时事 · 不予评论 no comment. 评价 judges quality.
Putting something into circulation: 发行货币/股票/债券 · 发行新专辑 · 发行量 circulation. 出版 is the publishing of a book itself.
Cuts things off: 得了，别说了 · 得了吧！yeah right. Also 'that'll do': 差不多就得了. Read dé le — 不得了 is a different word (bù dé liǎo).
Written; takes abstract or mass objects: 缺乏经验/信心/证据/资金. 缺少 fits countable things that are missing (还缺少两个人).
Two registers: chemistry — 化学物质 · 有害物质; and matter vs mind — 物质生活/精神生活 · 物质条件. Materials for building are 材料.
Formal, mostly attributive: 国民经济 · 国民素质 · 国民教育. 公民 carries the legal-rights sense. Modern slang: 国民老公/国民女神 the nation's crush.
Written, before a disyllabic verb: 难以想象/接受/置信/忘怀. Speech uses 很难+verb (很难忘).
Noun and verb: 发生冲突 clash · 武装冲突 · 利益冲突 conflict of interest · 时间冲突 scheduling clash · 和他起了冲突.
Figurative: 打击犯罪 crack down on · 受到打击 take a blow · 打击积极性 dampen morale. Literal hitting is 打; 打击 stays literal only in 打击乐器.
How a system is wired to work: 激励机制 · 监督机制 · 市场机制 · 建立/健全机制. 体制 is the institutional-system word; a physical mechanism is 装置.
Attributive: 私人医生/飞机/空间 · 私人企业 · 这是私人问题 none of your business. 个人 = pertaining to one person (个人观点); 私人 = not public.
Also an intensifier before abstract nouns/verbs: 高度重视 attach great importance to · 高度评价 rate highly · 高度紧张 highly tense. Not just physical height.
Verb-object (违+法), so it takes no object — name the law with 违反: 违反规定/法律. 违法行为 illegal act · 违法乱纪. 犯法 is the spoken twin.
Attaches to a role noun for 'acting X': 代理经理 acting manager · 代理总统 acting president. As noun: 代理商 (sales) agent/dealer, 代理人 legal agent.
Modifies a noun directly as 'annual X,' no 的: 年度报告 annual report · 年度预算 annual budget · 本年度 this fiscal year. Not casual 'this year' (that's 今年).
A faction's clout, usually ominous: 势力范围 sphere of influence · 黑恶势力 · 势力很大. 权力 is authority from office. Homophone trap: 势利 snobbish.
Your declared side on an issue: 坚持/表明立场 · 立场坚定 · 站在他的立场上想 see it from his position. A bodily stance is 姿势.
Direction depends on subject: 银行给他贷款 the bank loans him money; 他向银行贷款 he takes out a loan. Specifically bank loans — general borrowing is 借.
Formal localizer after a noun: X之外 = beyond/outside X. Often paired with 除了: 除了工作之外 apart from work. Family with 之内 (within) and 之下 (under).
Formal/written 'and then,' linking two narrated events, often starting a new clause: 他先...，随后... Less casual than 然后.
(written) Always precedes a verb phrase, often for attempts that fail: 试图逃跑 tried to flee. Contrast 尝试, which is neutral and can describe a successful try too.
Noun in practice: 引起争议 spark controversy · 有争议的人物 controversial figure · 存在争议 · 争议不断. A verb only in set phrases (无可争议).
Verb and noun: 尝试新方法 · 大胆尝试 · 一次失败的尝试. Casual speech prefers 试试/试一下; 试图 is written and hints the attempt failed.
Written localizer, mostly figurative: 压力之下 · 在他的帮助之下 · 相比之下 by comparison. Physically under something is 下面/底下.
Launching or emitting: 发射卫星/火箭/导弹 · 发射信号/电波. Firing a gun at a target is 射击/开枪.
Noun with 取得/获得: 取得重大突破. Verb: 突破纪录 break a record · 突破极限 · 突破自我. Also of figures: 销量突破百万 top a million.
= 'updates/goings-on,' not just 'dynamic': 朋友圈动态 social-feed updates · 关注动态 follow the latest news. Opposite 静态 (static).
For machines/systems/projects, not general 'begin' (that's 开始): 启动程序 launch a program · 启动资金 seed funding · 启动仪式 kickoff ceremony.
Fixed frame 以X为主 = X predominates: 以蔬菜为主 · 以自学为主. Same family: 以…为准 take as the standard · 以…为例 take as an example.
Officialese: 落实政策/责任/措施 · 抓落实 push it through. Also 'nailed down': 工作还没落实 the job isn't settled. 执行 is carrying out orders.
Bringing a big system under control: 治理污染/雾霾 · 治理河道 · 国家治理 · 公司治理 corporate governance. 管理 is day-to-day running of people/work.
解放前/解放后 = before/after 1949 on the mainland; 解放军 the PLA. Otherwise: 解放思想 · 解放双手 free up labor · 解放生产力.
Buying at scale: 收购公司 acquire a firm · 收购股份 · 收购粮食/废品 buy up from many sellers. 并购 is M&A; ordinary buying is 买/购买.
Mostly a noun: 记忆力 · 童年的记忆 · 记忆犹新 still vivid. As a verb it's written/technical (以便记忆 · 记忆单词); everyday 'memorize' is 记住/背.
Takes 为 before the position: 当选为总统 be elected president. Already passive in meaning — don't add 被.
Points back to a change already mentioned: 相应的措施/调整 · 价格涨了，服务也要相应改善 · 相应地增加. Needs that prior change to match.
Joining things physically or in a network: 连接南北 · 连接电源/网络 · 连接成功. A web hyperlink is usually 链接; contacting a person is 联系.
An official post carrying formal duties (免去…职务 remove from post). Contrast 职位 (the job slot/title, more neutral) and 职责 (the duties themselves).
Three uses: interpersonal friction (两人闹矛盾 fell out) · logical contradiction (自相矛盾) · feeling torn (我心里很矛盾).
The concealed facts of a specific event: 揭露真相 expose the truth · 真相大白 the truth comes out. Contrast 真理, universal/philosophical truth.
Physics term reused for people: 充满能量 · 正能量 uplifting stuff (mainstream, even official) · 负能量 a downer. Ability is 能力, a different word.
Often as 剩下的+noun = 'the remaining N': 剩下的部分 the leftover part. As a verb the subject is what's left: 蛋糕剩下一半 half the cake remains.
Attaches after a descriptor to name a demographic: 老年群体 the elderly (as a group) · 弱势群体 vulnerable groups. More formal than 人群 (a crowd).
Establishing something is true, usually with evidence: 证实消息属实 · 得到证实 · 未经证实的传言 unconfirmed rumor. 确认 pins down a detail (确认时间).
Often as 比预期/超出预期/达到预期 (than / exceeding / meeting expectations) — a benchmark, not an everyday verb like 希望 (hope).
As verb often takes 着: 象征着自由 symbolizes freedom. As noun: X的象征 a symbol of X, e.g. 乌鸦是不祥的象征.
Formal, systematic assessment, often with metrics: 风险评估 risk assessment · 评估表现 assess performance. Contrast 评价, a more general opinion/rating.
Graded tiers: 分为三个等级 · 会员等级 · 等级评定. Also social hierarchy: 等级制度 · 等级森严. Degree of intensity is 程度.
Written. 把X视为Y, and very often passive: 被视为理所当然 taken for granted · 被视为最大的威胁. 看作/当作 are the spoken equivalents.
Written. Needs an enabling cause in front: 有了大家的帮助，项目得以顺利完成 = was thereby able to. Not the homophone-ish 不得已 (bùdéyǐ, no choice).
Surpassing in quality/level/limits, often figurative: 超越自我/超越极限. Contrast 超过, neutral and quantitative (超过100人 more than 100 people).
(formal) Abstract goals only — help, solutions, cooperation: 寻求帮助/寻求解决办法. Not concrete objects; use 找 for those (找钥匙, not 寻求钥匙).
Institutional/project budget money (research grants, org funding) — not personal spending money (费用/花销) or investment capital (资金).
Adjective 他很可怜, also a verb 'to pity': 可怜可怜他吧 · 没人可怜你. And after an amount = pitifully: 少得可怜 · 工资低得可怜.
Follows a place word: 这一带 around here · 上海一带 the Shanghai area · 沿海一带 the coastal belt. Vague extent, never an administrative region (地区).
Always with a negative: 再也不迟到了 never again · 再也没见过他 haven't seen him since · 再也受不了了 can't take it any more.
As verb, takes the area of responsibility as object: 他主管财务 he's in charge of finance. As noun, a formal title (部门主管). Contrast everyday 负责.
Almost always in 到...为止: 到目前为止 so far/up to now · 报名到本周五为止 registration closes Friday. Rarely stands alone.
Two readings: after a number, 'N years ago' (十年前); bare 年前 = before Lunar New Year (年前把事办完), paired with 年后.
Escaping/detaching from a binding or dangerous condition, not just 'leaving': 脱离危险 out of danger · 脱离现实 detached from reality. Contrast plain 离开.
Two uses: after 的, the locus — 问题的所在 · 价值所在 (often without 的). Before a noun, 'where sb/sth is': 我所在的公司 · 所在地.
Official register: 驾驶证/驾照 license · 酒后驾驶 drunk driving · 驾驶飞机/轮船 · 无人驾驶 self-driving. Everyday driving is 开车.
For formal agreements between two+ parties (treaties, contracts) — not just signing your name (that's 签名/签字): 签订合同/协议.
More formal/institutional than 允许: often as noun/object — 得到许可 obtain permission, 许可证 permit/license (document).
Takes 成/为 for the resulting parts: 划分成四个小组 divide into 4 groups. For classification, not physical cutting (切/分割).
A quantitative target or metric (quota, KPI, index): 销售指标 sales quota · 经济指标 economic indicator. Not a general 'sign' (迹象/标志).
The principal bulk of something: 学生是活动的主体 · 主体建筑 main structure · 以…为主体. In law/econ, the acting party: 市场主体 · 责任主体.
(formal/legal) Adverb placed directly before the verb: 依法处罚/依法纳税. Set legal-register phrase, not casual speech.
Also modifies nouns as 'deep/in-depth': 深度分析 · 深度睡眠 · 深度清洁 · 深度参与. And 有深度 = substantive, of writing or of a person.
Written. Before a disyllabic verb whose object was already named — that verb takes none of its own: 需要加以修改 · 加以限制/说明. 予以 is its twin.
Qualitative/essential transformation: 阳光转化成能量 sunlight transforms into energy. Contrast 转换, more mechanical/technical switching (格式转换).
Formal, esp. judicial/moral impartiality (法官办事很公正 the judge is impartial). Contrast 公平, the everyday word for fair treatment/opportunity.
Literally 'both banks' (长江两岸), but in news it defaults to cross-strait: 两岸关系 · 两岸交流 = Taiwan and the mainland.
Two jobs: minimizing — 只不过是个玩笑（而已）; and 'it's just that…' introducing a snag: 我想去，只不过没时间.
Figurative cost paid, not a price tag (价格): 付出代价 pay the price · 代价惨重/高昂 · 不惜任何代价 at any cost.
Before a verb = do it first: 优先处理/考虑/安排. As a modifier: 优先权 · 优先级 priority level · 优先座 priority seat.
Broader than 出口 (trade only): 输出数据/能量 · 文化输出 · 内容输出 producing content. The other direction is 输入.
An official determination (法院认定他有罪 · 认定为工伤) or a conviction you won't budge from (他认定这事能成). Firmer than 认为.
The border zone: 边境地区/贸易 · 封锁边境 · 越过边境. 边界 is the line on the map (划定边界); 边疆 the far frontier region.
Formal 'lift/rescind' — takes a restriction, bond, or duty as object: 解除隔离 lift quarantine · 解除合同 terminate a contract · 解除职务 relieve of duties.
Two frames: 除非X，否则/要不然Y (unless X, then Y) and 除非X，才Y (only if X). The 除非 clause is the one exception that changes the outcome.
Two senses: a research institute, or (esp. Taiwan Mandarin) grad school — 考研究所 apply to grad school (mainland usually says 考研/读研究生).
Keeping a channel open: 保持联络 · 联络感情 keep relationships warm · 联络员 liaison. Contact info and one-off contacting use 联系 (联系方式).
Top corporate title, roughly CEO — 董事长 is board chairman, 总经理 general manager (usage varies by firm). Also a genre cliché: 霸道总裁 romances.
Abstract 'form/state' of matter or phenomena: 意识形态 ideology · 物质形态 state of matter. Contrast 形状, the concrete physical shape of an object.
Technical capability of a device or material: 手机性能 · 性能稳定/出色 · 性价比 value for money. A person's or team's performance is 表现.
Common in set terms for mobility: 流动人口 migrant population · 流动摊贩 mobile vendor · 流动资金 liquid capital. Broader than literal liquid flow.
For abstract things vanishing — fears, misunderstandings, hazards: 消除误解/隐患. Contrast 排除, ruling out a possibility or clearing an obstruction.
Founding something new and original — a company, school of thought, brand. Contrast 成立 (formally established, more neutral) and 建立 (build, general).
Mechanical/technical switching: 格式转换 file format conversion · 转换角色 switch roles. Contrast 转化, the more essential/qualitative transformation.
The formal organized contest: 数学竞赛 math olympiad · 知识竞赛 quiz contest · 竞赛项目 event · 参加竞赛. 比赛 is the everyday word and the default for a single match.
Funding as support, not publicity: 资助贫困学生 · 资助研究项目 · 得到资助 receive funding. Contrast 赞助, sponsorship bought for exposure (企业赞助活动).
Separable V-O (辞+职): 辞了职 · 提出辞职 · 辞职信 resignation letter. It can't take an object — name the post with 辞去经理职务, not 辞职经理.
Takes rules as its object: 遵守法律 · 遵守规定 · 遵守纪律 · 遵守交通规则 · 遵守时间 be punctual. Abstract principles take 遵循 (遵循原则/规律).
Attributive: 当代文学/艺术/社会 · 当代著名作家. In PRC periodization 现代 covers 1919–1949 and 当代 1949–now; loosely, 当代 is 'of our own time'.
Verb: be the official organizer, usually 由X主办 hosted by X · 主办方/主办单位 host organization · 主办城市. 举办 is the plain 'hold an event' (举办比赛).
More rigorous/technical than 检查 (everyday check): 检验产品质量. Also figurative: 经得起时间的检验 stand the test of time.
In practice it means Sina Weibo the platform, like saying 'Twitter': 发微博 post · 刷微博 scroll · 微博上 · 上热搜 hit the trending list.
Organized persuasion from above: 动员大家参加 · 动员群众 · 战争动员 · 总动员 general mobilization (玩具总动员 Toy Story). Pattern 动员某人做某事.
Written/legal 按照: 依照法律规定 · 依照合同 · 依照有关规定 · 依照说明书. Speech uses 按照 or 按; 依照 belongs to statutes and instructions.
Written/official 'inquire': 询问情况 · 询问意见 · 询问价格 · 向他询问 · 接受询问. Object can be either the topic or the person asked.
Orders from above, noun or verb: 上级的指示 · 下达指示 · 按指示办. Separate technical sense 'indicate': 指示灯 indicator light · 指示牌 signpost.
A recurring cycle with a fixed length: 洗涤周期 wash cycle · 生命周期 lifecycle. Contrast 时期 (an era/phase) and 期间 (during a span of time).
Buying for an organization: 采购部/采购员 · 政府采购 · 负责采购. Also bulk personal stocking-up: 采购年货 stock up for New Year. Ordinary shopping is 买.
Clearing things out, not just tidying a surface: 清理垃圾 · 清理库存 clear inventory · 清理缓存 clear cache · 清理房间. 打扫 is sweeping and mopping.
Written/technical 'go back': 返回上一页 · 返回首页 · 安全返回 · 返回值 return value (code). Everyday come/go back is 回来/回去.
The stated principle a thing runs on: 工作原理 how it works · 基本原理 · 科学原理. 道理 is everyday sense/reason; 理论 is a whole body of theory.
Inherent property of a material or system: 防水特性 · 物理特性 · 产品特性 · 新特性 new feature (software). 特点 is the everyday 'notable characteristic'.
Written 'formerly', heads a clause and usually contrasts with 现在: 以往……现在…… · 与以往不同. Unlike 以前 it can't follow a time word (三天以前, never 三天以往).
Adverb before the predicate: 依旧那么开朗 · 依旧如此 · 风景依旧. 依然 is the same word a notch less bookish; speech uses 还是/仍然.
Common in 在...(的)前提下 = 'on the premise/condition that...': 在安全的前提下. Also X是Y的前提 = X is a precondition for Y.
Two lives: institutional 'arts' (文艺节目/文艺演出/文艺工作者) and the slang adjective 'artsy, indie': 文艺青年 · 这家咖啡馆很文艺.
The job slot/title itself: 职位空缺 job vacancy · 竞争职位 compete for a position. More neutral than 职务, which emphasizes the duties attached to a post.
Neutral 'how things stand': 陷入僵持的局面 · 打开局面 get things moving · 大好局面 · 控制局面 · 扭转局面. 局势 is the bigger political/military picture.
Verb or attributive: 由她主导 she's driving it · 主导地位 dominant position · 主导作用 leading role · 占主导 · 主导产业 pillar industry.
A quality or scene comes into full view: 展现才华 · 展现出…的一面 · 美景展现在眼前. 展示 is deliberate showing (展示产品); 表现 is how one performs.
Noun for how things stand now: 改变现状 · 维持现状 · 满足于现状 be content as things are · 了解现状 · 现状调查.
Physical: verb 'move closer' (别靠近 · 船靠近岸边) or stative 'be next to' (座位靠近窗户). 接近 also works abstractly (接近成功/接近尾声).
Modifies verbs and nouns: 过度使用 · 过度疲劳 · 过度包装 · 过度解读. 过于 goes before adjectives (过于紧张). Homophone 过渡 = transition (过渡期).
Retrospective reflection on a past period: 回顾这一年 look back on the year · 回顾历史. Not academic review/study (that's 复习).
Extends along a line, literal or figurative: 公路向远方延伸 · 延伸到 · 向…延伸 · 延伸阅读 further reading · 词义的延伸.
The subject matter a work draws on: 战争题材的电影 · 爱情题材 · 现实题材 · 题材新颖. 主题 is the theme or message the work argues.
Spoken counterpart of 一生, used adverbially: 一辈子都住在这儿 · 干了一辈子 · 一辈子的朋友. Same 辈子 in 这辈子 · 下辈子 next life.
The level above you in a hierarchy: 上级部门/领导 · 向上级汇报 report upward · 服从上级; opposite 下级. 上司 is your own boss as a person.
One link in a chain of steps: 关键环节 · 薄弱环节 weak link · 中间环节 intermediate steps · 各个环节. Implies a sequence, unlike plain 部分.
Time as a remembered stretch, warm and literary: 美好时光 · 童年时光 · 时光飞逝 how time flies · 时光机. Clock time and duration are 时间.
Taking on a role/identity — literal acting (扮演小妖精 play a sprite) or figurative (扮演重要角色 play an important role in a situation).
Expectations placed on someone, usually by others: 对孩子抱有期望 · 不辜负期望 live up to · 期望值 (期望值太高). 希望 is your own hope.
Return on what you put in: 有回报 pay off · 投资回报率 ROI · 回报社会 give back · 回报父母. 报答 is only repaying a personal kindness.
A story's plot: 情节曲折/紧凑/吸引人. In law, the facts of the offence: 情节严重 aggravating circumstances. A general situation is 情况.
Formal assessment against criteria: 绩效考核 performance review · 对员工进行考核 · 考核标准 · 通过考核. An academic exam is 考试.
Rule out or clear away: 排除可能性 · 不排除 can't rule out · 排除故障 troubleshoot · 排除干扰 · 排除万难. 消除 dissolves the abstract (消除误会/顾虑).
出于 + a motive noun, never a clause: 出于好意 · 出于礼貌 · 出于安全考虑 for safety reasons · 出于无奈 having no choice · 出于对他的信任.
Written localizer on a quantity or scope: 三天之内 · 一公里之内 · 职权范围之内 within one's authority · 意料之内 as expected. Speech: 三天内/以内.
Craft technique: 绘画/写作/表现手法. Also the M.O. of wrongdoing: 作案手法 · 欺骗手法. 方法 is the neutral 'method' for getting anything done.
A standing opposition between two sides, not the act of opposing (反对): 意见对立 · 与…对立 · 对立面 the other side · 对立情绪 antagonism.
A leader calling followers to act: 号召大家参与 · 响应号召 answer the call · 号召力 pulling power. 呼吁 appeals, often upward (呼吁政府…).
Money and goods circulating (货币流通 · 流通领域 · 不再流通 no longer legal tender) — and air: 空气流通 ventilation. 流动 is general flow (人口流动).
Anatomy (神经系统 · 视神经) but also everyday slang for crazy: 神经病 · 你神经啊 · 神经兮兮 jumpy · 神经大条 oblivious.
Blaming someone out loud: 指责他不负责任 · 受到指责 · 遭到指责 · 互相指责. 批评 can be constructive; 指责 is pure fault-finding.
Written 'too, overly' before an adjective: 过于紧张 · 过于乐观 · 过于复杂. (The sentence's 莫过于 is a separate phrase: 最…莫过于X, nothing more so than X.)
The why behind an act, usually under suspicion: 犯罪动机 · 动机不纯 ulterior motives · 学习动机 motivation (psych). 动力 is the energy pushing you on.
Job title. Follows the boss's post: 经理助理 · 总裁助理; but precedes the rank in academic titles: 助理教授 · 助理研究员. 助手 is an informal helper.
Connects two clauses with the purpose stated SECOND: 做记录，以便记忆 take notes so as to remember. Contrast 为了, which usually fronts the purpose clause.
Impede rather than stop: 阻碍交通 · 阻碍发展 · 遇到阻碍 hit obstacles · 扫除阻碍. 阻止 is stopping an act outright (阻止他离开).
Marks the secondary aid, not the main actor: 辅助工具/设备/功能 · 辅助治疗 adjunct therapy · 辅助学生学习. 帮助 is plain 'help'.
Regulating to the right level: 调节音量 · 调节体温 · 调节情绪 · 空气调节 air conditioning. 'Mediate a dispute' is the homophone 调解 tiáojiě, not this word.
Rolling a policy out across an organization: 推行新制度 · 推行改革 · 大力推行 · 在全国推行. 实施 is neutrally putting a plan or law into effect.
The mandated role of a government body or department: 政府职能 · 职能部门 · 履行职能 carry out its functions. A device's function is 功能.
Takes a noun or a verb phrase: 渴望自由 · 渴望成功 · 渴望被理解 · 渴望得到认可. Also a noun: 对知识的渴望. Intense longing, not everyday 希望.
对…绝望 = give up on: 对他彻底绝望了 · 感到绝望 · 陷入绝望 · 绝望地哭. 失望 is mere disappointment; 绝望 is hope gone.
Interference that degrades something: 干扰信号 · 受到干扰 · 排除干扰 · 干扰我复习. 打扰 is the polite 'disturb' you apologize with (打扰一下).
Technical 'generate' — output produced by a process: 自动生成 · 生成文件/报告 · AI生成 · 生成式AI generative. 产生 is abstract 'give rise to' (产生影响).
Carries a trace of some quality with it: 带有南方口音 · 带有讽刺意味 an ironic tone · 带有强制性 mandatory in nature. More written than plain 有.
Willpower as a faculty: 意志力 · 意志坚强/薄弱 · 磨练意志 · 违背他的意志 against his will. 决心 is resolve about one specific thing.
Two uses: polite 'as you please' (你随意 · 随意点菜 · 请随意), and 'too casual, sloppy' as criticism: 穿得太随意 · 做事很随意.
Fire at, with 向/朝: 向目标射击 · 射击比赛 the shooting sport · 射击游戏 shooter. 发射 launches a rocket or missile; everyday 'fire a gun' is 开枪.
Conditions or a struggling manner: 生活艰难 · 艰难的决定 · 艰难地前行 · 不畏艰难 undaunted. A countable problem is 困难 (遇到困难/解决困难).
Making up for a lack, no fault or money required: 补偿他 · 作为补偿 · 心理补偿 · 补偿损失. 赔偿 is paying for damage you caused.
(formal/legal) Formally entrusting a task/authority: 委托律师 retain a lawyer · 委托书 power of attorney. Not the everyday 'please' (that's 拜托).
One-to-one mapping: 对应的答案 · 与…相对应 · 一一对应 · 对应关系. 相应 is looser 'corresponding, commensurate' (采取相应的措施).
How you regard something: 如何看待这个问题 · 正确看待 · 把他当朋友看待 regard as. 对待 is how you actually treat someone (对待客人).
Separable V-O (签+名): 签个名 · 签了名 · 要签名 get an autograph. Documents usually take 签字; concluding a contract is 签订.
Firm in stance or belief: 立场坚定 · 态度坚定 · 坚定地说 · 坚定不移 unswerving. Also a verb: 坚定信心. 坚强 is enduring hardship.
Combining parts into one: 化学合成 · 合成材料/纤维 synthetic · 合成照片 a composite/photoshopped image · AI合成 · 合成词 compound word.
Colloquially also means 'later': 回头再说 talk about it later · 回头见 see you later. Figurative 无法回头 = no going back, point of no return.
Official/institutional penalty — legal, administrative, workplace: 受到相应的处罚. Contrast 惩罚, the general word including personal contexts (parent punishing a child).
V-O (招+生), so no further object: 学校每年招生. For numbers use 招 alone (今年招了三千人). 招生简章 prospectus · 招生办 admissions office.
Abstract objects only: 确立地位 · 确立目标 · 确立原则/制度 · 确立关系. Founding a concrete body is 建立/成立 (建立公司 · 成立协会).
Forbidding someone; the subject is the authority: 妈妈不许我出门 · 我不许你去 · 不许说话. Always before a verb. 不能 states a rule or impossibility.
Of one's own free will, as against being made to: 自愿参加 · 自愿放弃 · 完全自愿 · 自愿原则. A volunteer is 志愿者, never 自愿者.
A universal truth: 追求真理 · 绝对真理 · 真理面前人人平等 · 检验真理. The hidden facts of one case are 真相 (查明真相 · 真相大白).
Stepping into what isn't yours to run: 政府干预市场 · 人为干预 · 早期干预 early intervention · 干预别人的生活. 干涉 always sounds like meddling (干涉内政).
The mortal world as against heaven: 人间仙境 earthly paradise · 人间地狱 hell on earth · 不食人间烟火 aloof from ordinary life. Plain 'world' is 世界.
Formally ending something already running: 终止合同/合作/协议 · 自动终止 · 终止妊娠 terminate a pregnancy. Everyday stopping is 停止.
Written connector 'from this': 由此可见 hence we can see · 由此看来 · 由此产生/引发 arising from this. Points back at what was just said.
Paying for damage you caused: 赔偿损失 · 赔偿金 damages · 要求赔偿 · 照价赔偿. 补偿 needn't involve fault or money.
Also causative: 震惊全国 · 震惊世界 · 令人震惊 shocking · 感到震惊 · 大为震惊. Stronger than 吃惊, and used of news that shocks a public.
Parse 原子弹 as 原子+弹, not 原+子弹. 弹 dàn = projectile: 炸弹 bomb · 导弹 missile · 子弹上膛 chamber a round. Read tán, 弹 means flick/play (弹钢琴).
Meteorology as a field: 气象局/气象台 · 气象预报 · 气象条件. Figurative 'air, aspect': 新气象 a fresh new look · 气象万千 a magnificent sight.
Submitting to what you're told: 服从命令 · 服从安排 · 服从管理 · 少数服从多数 minority yields to majority. Object is the order or the authority.
Restoring to a former state: 修复古迹 · 修复关系 · 修复漏洞 patch a bug · 修复受损皮肤. A broken appliance is usually just 修/修理.
Adjective, not an adverb: 联系很频繁 as predicate · 频繁(地)出差 · 频繁使用 · 频繁跳槽. Often implies 'too often'; 经常 only sits before the verb.
Levels stacked in a structure: 分成三个层次 · 高层次人才 top-tier talent · 各个层次 · 层次分明 clearly structured · 层次感 (hair, design) layering.
A title conferred as an honor: 授予…称号 confer · 获得…称号 · 荣誉称号 · 世界冠军的称号. 头衔 is the job or rank title on your card.
Equipping an organization or product with what it needs: 配备了最新设备 · 配备人员 assign staff · 车上配备安全气囊 · 配备齐全.
In high demand right now: 热门话题 · 热门专业 · 热门景点 · 很热门. Opposite 冷门 obscure, a long shot. 流行 is 'in fashion' (流行音乐).
Holding what others want a share of: 占有市场份额 · 市场占有率 market share · 占有一席之地 hold a place · 占有欲 possessiveness. Plain ownership is 拥有.
Defending against an enemy: 保卫祖国 · 保卫和平 · 保卫家园 · 保卫科 security office. 保护 is protecting from harm generally (保护环境/眼睛).
Noun or V-O: 交罚款 pay the fine · 罚款单 ticket · 罚款500元 · 被罚款. To name who's fined, use 罚 with a double object: 罚了他200元.
Official talks between delegations: 举行/进行会谈 · 双边会谈 · 六方会谈 · 会谈成果. A private conversation is 谈话/交谈.
Public order in the crime sense: 社会治安 · 维持治安 · 治安好/差 · 治安案件. Not personal safety (安全) or orderly procedure (秩序).
Verb (老师示范一遍) or noun with a light verb (做示范/进行示范). Attributive: 示范作用 demonstration effect · 示范项目/基地 model project.
A process or connection breaks off: 比赛/联系/谈判中断了. Also transitive: 中断学业 · 中断合作. Cutting into someone's speech is 打断 (打断他的话).
A belt or strip of land with one defining trait: 危险地带 · 灰色地带 gray area · 安全地带 · 沿海地带 coastal belt. Plain 'area' is 地区/区域.
Verb: 诊断为肺炎 diagnose as · 被诊断出癌症 · 诊断病情. Noun: 做出诊断 · 诊断结果 · 诊断书 medical certificate. Getting it wrong is 误诊.
The impersonal cue: 系统提示 · 提示音 · 温馨提示 'friendly notice' · 给点提示 give a hint. A person reminding you is 提醒 (提醒我别忘了).
Mostly attributive: 终身伴侣 lifelong partner · 终身教授 tenured · 终身学习 · 终身监禁 life imprisonment · 终身大事 marriage. 一生 is the plain noun.
Written 'follow': 跟随他多年 · 跟随潮流 · 跟随者 follower. Everyday physical following is 跟着 (跟着我走); following an account is 关注.
Noun: 住房/生活补贴 · 发/领/申请补贴 · 政府补贴. Verb: 补贴家用 help cover household costs. 资助 is funding a person or project.
An academic research project: 研究课题 · 课题组 · 申请课题. Also 'an issue that has to be tackled': 面临的重大课题. A plain task is 任务.
Looking up to someone senior: 尊敬长辈/老师 · 受人尊敬 respected. Letters open with it: 尊敬的王教授. 尊重 = respect anyone's views, choices, rights.
Things supplied as a matching set with the main item: 配套设施 amenities · 配套措施 accompanying measures · 配套政策 · 与…相配套 · 配套齐全.
Takes an NP object directly: 不顾一切 at all costs · 不顾后果 · 不顾我们的感受 · 不顾反对. 不管 needs a question word or A-not-A clause (不管他来不来).
Written, literary sadness: 感到悲伤 · 悲伤的往事 · 陷入悲伤 · 悲伤的音乐. Speech uses 难过, or 伤心 for hurt feelings.
Written 'at this moment', for narration and speeches: 此时此刻 at this very moment · 此刻的心情. Same bookish 此- as 此地/此事. Speech uses 现在.
Looking something up in a system: 查询余额 · 查询成绩 · 在线查询 · 查询结果. Asking a person is 问/咨询; the plain verb is 查 (查一下).
Harsh in manner or punishment: 严厉批评 · 严厉打击 crack down · 严厉的目光 · 态度严厉. 严格 is strict about standards (严格要求/严格执行).
Formal 'lead', with an organized group as object and usually what they do after: 率领球队夺冠 · 率领代表团访问 · 率军出征. Everyday: 带领.
V不住 potential complement (忍+不住), directly followed by a verb phrase: 忍不住哭了/笑了. Positive form: 忍得住 = can hold back。
The legal system as machinery: 法制建设 · 健全法制 · 法制教育. Exact homophone 法治 = rule of law as a principle (依法治国 · 法治社会).
Passing a message on — officially (传达指示 · 传达文件精神) or plainly (把消息传达给他). 转达 is relaying someone's own words: 代我转达问候.
Holding behavior in check by rules: 约束自己 · 自我约束 · 受法律约束 · 不受约束 · 约束力 binding force. 制约 is limitation by structural factors.
Sits straight before the noun or verb, no 地 needed: 间接原因 · 间接影响 · 间接导致 · 间接经验 · 间接费用. Opposite 直接.
For stretches of time that drag: 漫长的等待 · 漫长的冬天 · 漫长的岁月 · 路途漫长. A physical object's length is just 长 (这条路很长).
为期 + duration, then the event: 为期三天的培训 · 为期一周的展览; or as predicate: 培训为期三天. Written, and only for scheduled events.
A problem that nags at someone over time: 问题困扰着他 · 被失眠困扰 · 受…困扰 · 摆脱困扰 · 带来困扰. 打扰 is a brief interruption.
Written 不容易, and 'not readily' before a verb: 不易察觉 hard to notice · 不易变形 · 不易保存. Set phrases: 实属不易 · 来之不易 hard-won.
Licensed and proper, as against shady: 正规平台/医院/渠道 · 正规军 regular army · 不正规. 正式 is 'formal, official' of occasions and procedures.
Rare and treasured, concrete or remembered: 珍贵的文物/照片/回忆/友谊. 宝贵 pairs with what shouldn't be wasted: 宝贵的时间/经验/机会/生命.
Judgment and taste: 有眼光 a good eye · 眼光独到 · 眼光很高 picky · 用发展的眼光看问题. A literal gaze is 目光 (目光转向他).
Verb takes 到 plus what came to mind: X让人联想到Y · 由此联想到… As a noun: 引起联想 · 丰富的联想 · 联想能力.
Spoken 'week': 这个礼拜 · 上/下礼拜 · 礼拜三 Wednesday · 礼拜天 Sunday. Also worship: 做礼拜 go to church. 星期 is the neutral form.
Noun as much as verb: 得到启发 · 很有启发 eye-opening · 对我启发很大. As a verb it means prompting someone to work it out: 启发学生思考.
Mostly fixed uses: 预备党员 probationary Party member · 预备役 reserves · 预备铃 warning bell · 预备，跑! ready, go! Everyday 'prepare' is 准备.
'More than' before a quantity (不止五十人 · 不止一次) or 'without stopping' after a verb (哭个不止 · 血流不止). Homophone 不只 = 'not only'.
Adjective 'sound, complete': 身心健全 · 健全的制度. Also a verb, 'shore up': 建立健全…制度 · 健全法律法规 — a stock phrase in policy writing.
防 + 治, prevent and treat: 防治空气污染 · 疾病防治 · 病虫害防治 · 加强防治. The object is the harm itself — disease, pest, pollution.
The spot on a body or object: 受伤部位 · 疼痛部位 · 身体各部位 · 关键部位. A location in space is 位置; a place is 地方.
Adverbial too: 难得聚在一起 rarely get to · 难得来一次 · 难得糊涂. Adjective: 难得的机会/人才. On its own it's praise: 真难得.
Attributive, or predicative with 是…的: 一流的服务 · 世界一流大学 · 服务是一流的. It doesn't take 很 like ordinary adjectives. Tiers: 一流/二流/三流.
Breaking a rule: as a modifier 违规停车/操作/收费, or on its own 他违规了 · 属于违规 · 严重违规. 违法 is breaking the law; 违约 breaking a contract.
A person's features (姐妹俩的面貌) and, more often in writing, the overall state of a thing: 城市面貌 · 精神面貌 mental outlook · 面貌一新 take on a whole new look.
Verb-object: the other party takes 与/和/跟, not the object slot — 与新公司签约 · 签了约. Attributive: 签约作家/球员 under contract. 签字 is just inking your name.
The scene as it looks and feels: 热闹的场面 · 场面很大 · 控制场面 keep order · 场面话 empty pleasantries. 场合 is the occasion that dictates behavior (正式场合).
Verb and noun: 你设想一下 imagine for a moment · 提出一个设想 float a tentative plan · 大胆设想. Set phrase 后果不堪设想 the consequences don't bear thinking about.
The words actually spoken: 不需要言语 · 言语之间 · 言语上的冲突 · 不善言语 not talkative. 语言 is language as a system (中文, 语言学).
Written. The object attaches directly, no 对: 有利于健康/发展/双方合作. Spoken paraphrases: 对身体有好处 · 对…有利.
Abstract factors do the limiting: 受…制约 be constrained by · 相互制约 mutual checks · 制约因素 limiting factor. 约束 is restraining behavior by rules.
Indignant 'clearly' — asserts a fact against what someone claims. A 却/还 clause usually follows (明明知道却不说), but the contradiction can just sit in the context.
The good result an effort yields: 初见成效 start to pay off · 取得成效 · 成效显著 · 卓有成效 highly effective. 效果 is the neutral word and can be bad.
Warm, elevated care, usually flowing downward (parents, leaders, the state): 关怀备至 utterly attentive · 无微不至的关怀 · 人文关怀. Everyday caring is 关心.
Discipline handed to a member by an institution: 受到处分 · 给予…处分 · 记过/开除处分 demerit/expulsion. 处罚 is an official penalty; 惩罚 is punishment generally.
Attributive noun for the fire-service domain: 消防员/车/队 · 消防栓 hydrant · 消防通道 fire lane · 消防演习 drill. The verb for putting out a fire is 灭火.
Usually a flaw someone can exploit: 钻法律的漏洞 exploit a loophole · 安全/系统漏洞 · 堵住漏洞 plug the gap · 漏洞百出 riddled with holes.
As alarm it stands alone up front: 完了，钥匙忘带了. Also colloquial 'and then': 完了我们就回家了. Otherwise just V+完了 (我说完了).
Usually the person: 当裁判 · 主裁判 head ref · 裁判员 · 服从裁判. The verb sense is legal register (裁判案件); refereeing a match is 给比赛当裁判.
Transitive: 忍受痛苦/寂寞/噪音. Very often in the potential form — 忍受不了 · 无法忍受. 忍耐 is patient endurance and can stand alone (再忍耐一下).
Adverb 'might as well just —', cutting the dithering: 干脆住一晚 · 干脆别去了 · 干脆直说吧. Adjective of manner: 说话干脆 blunt and decisive · 干脆利落.
Literary 'the years' as lived time: 漫长的岁月 · 艰苦的岁月 · 岁月不饶人 time spares no one · 岁月的痕迹. Counting years is 年, never 岁月.
Intransitive, of countables growing more numerous: 人数/订单/机会增多. 增大 is size or degree (压力增大); the general transitive verb is 增加 (增加人手).
Written/narrative 没(有)…过, and 过 can still follow: 不曾想到 never expected · 不曾见过 · 从不曾后悔. Speech says 没想到/没见过.
Noun: 睡眠不足 sleep deprivation · 睡眠质量 · 充足的睡眠 · 睡眠模式 sleep mode. The verb 'to sleep' is 睡觉/睡.
Two lines of use: moving people or forces (调动工作/岗位 · 工作调动 · 调动部队) and mobilizing intangibles (调动积极性/情绪/一切力量).
Medical register, object is the substance: 注射疫苗/胰岛素 · 静脉注射 IV · 注射器 syringe. Getting a shot in everyday speech is 打针.
VO: 签个字 · 签了字 · 在合同上签字 · 签字仪式 signing ceremony. 签约 is concluding the deal; 签名 is a signature or autograph as a thing.
Written; the subject is the vehicle or vessel: 在快车道上行驶 · 安全行驶 · 高速行驶 · 逆向行驶 drive against traffic. People walking is 行走.
Adverb 'every so often': 不时抬头 · 不时传来笑声. Colloquial twin 时不时(地). 随时 is 'at any moment, whenever needed' (随时可以找我).
Attributive only: 内在美 inner beauty · 内在原因/联系 · 内在价值. Opposite 外在. As a predicate about a person, say 有内涵, not 很内在.
Transitive, object is what you dodge: 回避问题/责任/矛盾 · 回避不了. Legal sense: 回避制度 recusal. 避免 is preventing an outcome (避免错误).
Pride in something you belong to, always positive: 为…感到自豪 · 自豪地说 · 民族自豪感. 骄傲 covers the same pride but also means arrogant.
Almost always 被公认为 X or attributive 公认的: 公认的事实 · 公认的权威 · 世界公认. The subject is the thing recognized, not the people recognizing it.
Covered in it: 一身汗/泥/水 · 一身湿透. Or a whole outfit: 一身西装 · 一身黑. Also a whole stock of something: 一身本事 · 一身债.
Of conditions and effort: 生活/条件艰苦 · 艰苦的环境 · 艰苦奋斗 struggle on · 艰苦朴素 plain living. A hard problem or a difficulty is 困难.
Adverb after the subject, flagging a contrast with expectation: 效果倒是很好 · 他倒是不介意. Also a nudge in speech: 你倒是说句话啊 come on, say something.
Takes an abstract stage or position: 处在…阶段/时期/状态 · 处在有利位置. Physical location is 位于/在. Written twin 处于 is commoner in formal prose.
Physics: 摩擦力 friction. Figuratively a low-grade clash: 产生摩擦 · 双方有些摩擦 · 贸易摩擦 trade friction — milder than 冲突.
Written tally word before the figure: 共计五千元 · 共计三十人 · 共计花了…. Speech uses 一共/总共.
The fleeing itself: 临阵逃跑 flee before battle · 逃跑路线 · 犯人逃跑了. Overlaps 逃走, which leans on having got clear away.
Predicate about the substance: 这种蘑菇有毒 · 有毒气体/物质. Net slang for 'something's wrong with it': 这游戏有毒. A poisoned person is 中毒.
Beyond the color: 灰色地带 gray area · 灰色收入 off-the-books income · 灰色产业. Also 'bleak': 灰色的心情 · 灰色的人生.
The size of a change: 幅度很大 · 涨价幅度 · 大幅度增长/下降 (adverbial). Written prose often shortens it to 大幅: 大幅上涨.
-长 = head of whichever 团 is meant: a regiment, a delegation or troupe (代表团/剧团团长), and in community group-buying the neighborhood organizer (拼团团长).
Adverbially, straight-line = steeply and without pause: 直线上升/下降 · 销量直线飙升. Literal geometry: 画一条直线 · 两点之间直线最短.
Object is usually something losable: 珍惜时间/机会/生命/这段友谊 · 好好珍惜 · 值得珍惜. 珍贵 is the adjective for the precious thing (珍贵的礼物).
Three uses: hand over and brief (把工作交代给同事) · instruct (交代任务) · account for or confess (向领导/警察交代). Noun: 给大家一个交代.
A reply to a request or inquiry, noun or verb: 给我一个答复 · 等待答复 · 明天答复你 · 正式答复. Answering a question is 回答.
Resultative 制+成, nearly always in 用/由 Y 制成: 用竹子制成的 · 由塑料制成. Label/written register; speech says 用竹子做的.
Upkeep that keeps something in shape: 保养皮肤 skincare · 汽车保养/做保养 servicing · 保养得很好 well-preserved. 修养 is personal cultivation.
对…过敏 as a predicate (我对花生过敏); in noun phrases the allergen compounds directly: 花粉过敏 · 皮肤过敏 · 过敏源 allergen. Figurative: 他对批评很过敏.
Noun+十足 = brimming with it: 信心/干劲/底气十足. Also 十足的 + noun = utter, one hundred percent: 十足的骗子 · 有十足的把握.
中 is read zhòng here. VO: 中了毒 · 食物中毒 food poisoning · 煤气中毒. Figurative 'hooked': 他中毒太深. The substance's own property is 有毒.
VO — the opponent takes 跟/和: 跟他打架 · 打了一架 · 打起架来. Hitting a person directly is 打人.
The astronomical body: 登上月球 · 月球表面 · 月球探测器 lunar probe · 绕月球运行. The moon you look at in the sky is 月亮.
Literal blossoms (桃花开了 · 桃花源). The romance sense lives in set phrases: 走桃花运 be lucky in love · 桃花劫 a romance that brings trouble.
Fled and got clear — 走 marks the departure: 小偷逃走了 · 让他逃走了 let him get away. Overlaps 逃跑, which names the act of fleeing (临阵逃跑).
A measurable level rising by itself: 气温/水位/血压升高. 提高 is raising something deliberately (提高质量/水平); 上升 is neutral for figures and trends.
Earning by working: 挣钱养家 · 挣了点钱 · 挣不了几个钱. 赚钱 leans toward profit from business, but in speech the two overlap heavily.
Adverbial 'in one go': 一口气跑完五公里 · 一口气看完. The literal breath survives in 松了一口气 sigh of relief · 喘口气 catch your breath.
Equal in quantity or value, measurement register: 数量/面积/价值相等 · 两者基本相等 · 完全相等. Being the same in kind or content is 相同.
把X看成Y regard X as Y (把失败看成锻炼). Also 'mistake for': 我把他看成他哥了. Formal equivalents 视为/看作.
Of size, degree or magnitude: 噪音/压力/难度增大. Also transitive: 增大投入. 增多 is for countables getting more numerous (人数增多).
Bound form — it lives in compounds: 天文学 astronomy · 天文台 observatory · 天文望远镜. Figurative: 天文数字 an astronomical sum.
Scenery as a whole vista: 塞外风光 · 风光优美/秀丽 · 异国风光. Also 'basking in glory': 他现在很风光 · 风风光光地办婚礼.
Formal concern expressed by a visit or gift to those who suffered or serve: 慰问伤员/灾民 · 慰问品/慰问信 · 表示慰问. Comforting someone personally is 安慰.
Of abstract things that ought to be solid: 基础薄弱 · 意志薄弱 weak-willed · 力量薄弱 · 薄弱环节 weak link. A frail body is 虚弱.
Noun and verb: 破除迷信 · 她有点迷信. Extends to blind faith in anything: 迷信权威 · 迷信名牌 · 别迷信专家.
Health: 脸色很差/苍白 · 脸色好多了. Mood: 看人脸色 live at someone's mercy · 给他脸色看 show displeasure · 脸色一沉 darken.
有修养 cultured, well-mannered · 没修养 · 个人修养. Also attainment in a field: 艺术/文学修养. 保养 is upkeep of things; 休养 is resting to recover.
Set modest deflection of praise or of a lofty title: 哪里哪里，不敢当 · 真不敢当 · 这个称号我可不敢当.
VO 'get past the beginner stage': 学了三年才入门 · 还没入门. Attributive 'introductory': 入门书/教程/课程 · 入门级 entry-level.
VO — the person applauded takes 为/给: 为他鼓掌 · 给她鼓个掌. Also 热烈鼓掌 · 鼓掌欢迎 · 鼓掌通过 approve by acclamation.
振动 is regular mechanical oscillation: 空气振动 · 振动频率 · 手机振动. Homophone 震动 is a jolt or shock, often figurative: 消息震动全国.
Colloquial and northern: 个儿高/矮 · 大个儿 a big guy · 比个儿 compare heights. Also 'by the piece': 论个儿卖. Neutral word is 个子.
Written, usually with 着: 注视着窗外 · 目不转睛地注视. Figurative watching of events: 密切注视事态发展. Everyday staring is 盯着.
舍不得 + verb or person: 舍不得扔 · 舍不得离开 · 舍不得孩子. Often specifically grudging the expense: 舍不得花钱/买. Positive form 舍得.
Storytelling device right after an action — 'and there was…': 打开门，只见他站在门口 · 只见他一把抓住绳子. Written narrative; no subject before it.
Ordinal placeholder like 'A': 甲乙丙丁 (A, B, C, D...); also 甲方/乙方 = Party A/Party B in contracts.
Stative: 我很为难 · 感到为难 · 左右为难 torn either way. Transitive: 别为难他 don't put him on the spot · 故意为难人.
Discourse opener 'in a word, to sum up': 一句话，这个计划失败了 · 一句话，我们得走了. Also 一句话的事儿 a trivial thing to ask.
Part of a fixed set: 冠军 1st place · 亚军 2nd/runner-up · 季军 3rd place.
Separable VO: 值了三天班, 轮流值班 (take turns on duty). Shift types: 值夜班/值早班.
舍得 + verb: 舍得花钱/花时间 · 你舍得吗？ Willingness to give up something you value. The negative 舍不得 is far more common in speech.
The bumper harvest itself: 粮食丰收 · 今年大丰收 · 丰收的季节. Figurative for any big haul: 这次比赛大丰收. Doing the harvesting is 收割/收获.
VO with no object of its own: 受灾地区/群众 · 受灾严重 · 受灾面积. To name the disaster use 遭受: 遭受洪灾.
Formal, public-notice register: 乘车路线 · 文明乘车 · 乘车前往. General verb 乘坐(飞机/地铁); everyday speech says 坐车.
Emphatic double negative, typically with a verb of judging: 不能不说 one has to say · 不能不承认 · 不能不让人佩服. Plain compulsion is 不得不.
Repaying kindness, not money: 报答父母 · 报答养育之恩 · 无以报答 · 用…来报答. Paying back a loan is 还钱/偿还.
The impressions an experience leaves: 谈谈感想 · 有什么感想？ · 发表感想 · 读后感想. A plan or an opinion is 想法/看法.
Written adverb before the verb, marking a natural consequence: 不免有些紧张 · 不免让人失望. 难免 means the same but can also be a predicate (这也是难免的).
Outpatient service: 看门诊 · 挂门诊号 · 门诊部 · 专家门诊 · 门诊时间. Contrast 急诊 emergency and 住院 inpatient.
Resultative 搞+好 = get X into good shape: 搞好关系 build good relations · 搞好卫生/学习. 搞 is colloquial and can sound slapdash; writing prefers 做好/办好.
VO: 向/给家里汇款 · 汇了一笔款 · 汇款单/汇款人. Also a noun: 收到一笔汇款. Sending to an account is 汇到…账户.
Bound form; the standalone word is 老鼠. Compounds: 鼠标 computer mouse · 松鼠 squirrel · 袋鼠 kangaroo · 属鼠 born in the Year of the Rat · 胆小如鼠.
胆(gall)+小; the natural sentence form is 他胆子小. 胆小鬼 coward · 胆小如鼠 · 从小胆小. Opposite 胆大 (胆大心细 bold but careful).
厂+长: the productive '-长' suffix for 'head of X' — same pattern as 校长 (principal), 组长 (team lead), 部长 (minister)。
The person who leads you through unfamiliar terrain: 当向导 · 请个向导 · 找了个当地向导. A professional tour guide is 导游.
Written; the whole look on a face: 神情严肃/凝重/紧张 · 神情自若 composed. 表情 is the everyday word, and the one for a specific expression or an emoji.
Of ground and roads being level: 路面平坦 · 平坦的草原 · 一路平坦. Figurative for a smooth life course: 人生道路并不平坦. A flat surface is just 平.
The verb is 说: 说相声 · 听相声 · 说了一段相声. 相声演员 performer · 对口相声 the two-hander · 单口相声 solo.
Aching sympathy for someone you love (心疼孩子 · 看得人心疼) and grudging a waste: 心疼钱 · 心疼那些时间. Often 心疼得不得了.
Potential form (着 zháo), takes a whole clause: 用不着你亲自跑 · 用不着这么客气. Dismissive version of 不需要. Positive: 以后用得着.
Shooting video: 摄像机 camcorder · 摄像头 webcam/CCTV camera · 摄像师 videographer · 负责摄像. 摄影 covers stills and cinematography.
Spoken, northern, warm and inclusive: 大伙儿一起干 · 我们大伙儿 · 大伙儿说说. Neutral and written is 大家.
Dated-colloquial 'having a good time', usually as a complement: 玩得很快活 · 过得快活 · 快快活活. Modern speech says 开心; 快乐 is the general word.
Fixed collocations: 打比方/打个比方 (put it this way) · 比方说 (for example)。
Almost always with 有: 很有风度 · 有绅士风度 · 保持风度 keep your poise · 风度翩翩 graceful and elegant. Of bearing, not of looks.
Verb: 选修了一门心理学 · 选修两门课. Modifier: 选修课 elective. Opposite 必修(课) required.
Reading a text out clearly, classroom or broadcast: 朗读课文 · 朗读比赛. 朗诵 is performed recitation of poetry; plain 念 is just reading it aloud.
Describes 天气/天空/日子: 天气晴朗 · 晴朗的天空 · 晴朗的一天. Slightly written — a forecast or casual speech says 晴/晴天.
VO — the person takes 向/朝: 向我们招手 · 招了招手 · 招手打车 hail a cab. 招手 beckons someone over; waving goodbye is 挥手.
Colloquial localizer after a person: 走到我跟前 · 到他跟前去 · 孩子不在跟前 not around. Neutral written form is 面前.
Productive derogatory suffix: X鬼 = person plagued by/addicted to X — 酒鬼 drunkard, 烟鬼 chain smoker, 小气鬼 miser, 胆小鬼 coward。
Derogatory label, not a clinical one: 他是个酒鬼 · 老酒鬼. Same 鬼 suffix as 烟鬼/赌鬼. The medical term is 酗酒者.
The strain felt by the doer: 走得很吃力 · 学起来有点吃力 · 对他来说很吃力 · 吃力不讨好 hard work and no thanks for it.
Of big structures and landscape: 雄伟的建筑/山峰/大桥 · 气势雄伟 · 雄伟壮观. A person or an achievement being great is 伟大.
Open to being taught: 虚心请教 ask humbly for advice · 虚心接受批评 · 虚心学习. 谦虚 is the general modest-personality word (他很谦虚).
The document you sign: 签订一份协议书 · 合作/离婚协议书. 协议 is the agreement itself (达成协议); -书 marks the written instrument, like 申请书/说明书.
Undesired verb: 差点儿撞到 = 差点儿没撞到, both 'almost hit'. A wanted outcome splits: 差点儿考上 didn't get in · 差点儿没考上 just barely did.
Colloquial and northern for 剪刀: 一把剪子 · 用剪子剪 · 石头剪子布 rock-paper-scissors. Written and neutral is 剪刀.
Always names the notice type: 寻人/寻物启事 · 招聘启事 job posting · 征稿启事 call for submissions. Homophone trap: 启示 is a revelation or lesson.
Same word as 差点儿, just fuller, and 就 often follows: 差一点儿就忘了 · 差一点儿摔倒. With an undesired verb, adding 没 changes nothing.
别慌 don't panic · 心里发慌 · 慌了神 lose your head. Also a colloquial intensifier in Adj+得慌: 闷得慌 stiflingly dull · 累得慌 · 饿得慌.
Top-level and long-term: 战略目标 · 战略伙伴 strategic partner · 战略眼光 · 从战略上看. 策略 is the approach chosen to execute it; 战术 is battlefield tactics.
VO — the offence slots in: 犯了罪 · 犯抢劫罪 commit robbery · 犯故意杀人罪. As a modifier: 犯罪率 · 犯罪嫌疑人 suspect · 青少年犯罪.
Mostly the noun: 为…做出贡献 · 作出巨大贡献 · 有贡献. As a verb it takes 给/为 plus a cause: 把一生贡献给教育事业.
Any organized body or line: 队伍很长 the queue is long · 游行队伍 · 教师队伍 the teaching corps · 一支队伍. Troops proper are 部队.
News-report register, straight before the verb: 首次访华 · 首次公开亮相 · 全球首次. Ordinary speech and narration use 第一次.
Resultative — competence reached, not effort spent: 学会开车/游泳 · 学不会 · 还没学会. The same syllables are also a noun: 中国物理学会 the Physical Society.
Something breaking out suddenly and at scale: 战争/疫情/危机爆发 · 火山爆发 volcanic eruption · 爆发力 explosive power. A bomb going off is 爆炸.
Political and ideological register: 阶级斗争 · 为…而斗争 struggle for · 同…作斗争 fight against · 斗争精神. An everyday quarrel is 争吵.
Written, and the object is abstract: 给予支持/帮助/关注/高度评价 · 给予处分. Handing over a physical thing is plain 给 (给我一杯水).
Grand, classical 'the realm': 一统天下 · 打天下 win power · 天下第一 · 天下大乱 · 天下没有免费的午餐. The ordinary world is 世界.
An authority vetting something for approval or wrongdoing: 审查资格/文件 · 接受审查 be investigated · 内容审查 content review. 检查 is a neutral inspection.
VO: 投了一票 · 投票给他 / 投他一票 · 投赞成票 vote in favor · 投票率 turnout.
Verb with a direct object (抗议这个决定) or noun with 提出: 向…提出抗议 · 表示抗议 · 强烈抗议 · 抗议活动 protest event.
Formal, and you are the secondary party: 协助我完成工作 · 协助警方调查 · 在…的协助下. Pattern: 协助 + person + the task.
Colloquial concessive; the second clause needs 也: 就算下雨，我也要去 · 就算是他也不行. Written equivalents 即使/即便.
The object is always something bad, usually disyllabic: 遭到反对/批评/拒绝/袭击. 遭受 takes hardships (遭受损失); the neutral one is 受到 (受到欢迎).
Topic shift at the head of a clause: 至于这个问题，以后再说. Separate sense 'go that far': 不至于吧！ · 他不至于骗你.
A physical blast: 炸弹爆炸 · 爆炸声/威力 · 爆炸案. Figurative for runaway growth: 信息爆炸 · 人口爆炸. Wars and epidemics take 爆发.
Weighty word for a figure who commands allegiance: 国家领袖 · 精神领袖 · 领袖人物 · 民权运动领袖. Applied to a team it is praise; the job title is 领导.
Written/medical, and a category noun: 预防疾病 · 各种疾病 · 传染性疾病 · 心血管疾病. 'I'm sick' is 病了/生病.
Noun and verb, weighty: 作出承诺 · 兑现承诺 keep a promise · 承诺书 written pledge · 他承诺明年完工. Casually agreeing to a request is 答应.
Two senses: goods hitting the market (新品上市 · 草莓上市了 in season) and a company going public (公司上市 · 上市公司 listed firm · 即将上市).
