Faith in a religion or ideology, noun or verb: 信仰宗教 · 宗教信仰 · 信仰自由 · 有信仰的人. Believing a person or a statement is 相信.
The concrete approach serving a 战略 (grand strategy): 销售策略 · 调整策略 · 应对策略 · 策略性 tactical. Also an adj, 'tactful': 说话很策略.
Verb 协调双方/各部门/关系 — and an adjective meaning well-matched: 颜色很协调 · 比例协调 · 动作不协调 uncoordinated · 协调性.
Noun only, so it needs a verb: 存在差异 there is a difference · 缩小差异 narrow the gap · 文化差异 · 个体差异. Saying two things differ is 不同.
The courtroom/tribunal hearing a case: 在法庭上 · 上法庭 go to court · 出庭 appear · 法庭辩论. The institution and the building are 法院.
Solemn euphemism for dying on duty (为国牺牲 · 牺牲的战士), and giving something up for a goal: 牺牲时间/健康/个人利益 · 不惜牺牲.
Escalates off a baseline already stated: 平时就忙，周末更是… · 不仅…更是…. Before a noun phrase it is copular: 这不仅是习惯，更是一种态度.
Two flavors: official 'foreign/external' — 对外贸易 · 对外开放 · 对外政策; and 'to outsiders/the public' — 对外营业 · 别对外说. Opposite 对内.
Verb and noun, for reacting to anything said or done: 回应质疑/关切 · 作出回应 · 正面回应 · 一直没有回应. Answering a question is 回答.
Written/clinical for 病人, and productive after a disease name: 糖尿病患者 · 癌症患者 · 重症患者 · 患者家属. Speech says 病人.
An organization or system in operation: 公司运作良好 · 市场化运作 · 资本运作. Machines and systems 运行; running a business as a business 运营.
Offense in war or sport: 发起进攻 · 主动进攻 · 进攻对方球门 · 进攻型球员. A verbal or personal attack is 攻击 (人身攻击).
Attributive: 知名企业 · 知名人士 · 国内很知名的设计师. As a bare predicate 有名/出名 is more natural. Very common derivative: 知名度 name recognition.
Noun: 有…的倾向 · 政治倾向 · 倾向性. As a verb it needs 于: 倾向于同意 lean toward agreeing · 我更倾向于第二个方案.
举行仪式 hold a ceremony · 开幕/颁奖/结婚仪式 · 参加仪式 · 仪式感 sense of occasion (very common now).
通讯工具 · 通讯录 contact list · 通讯社 news agency · 新闻通讯 dispatch. Overlaps with 通信 for telecoms — the technical field is 通信工程.
Officially annul something already issued: 撤销决定/命令/处分 · 撤销职务 · 撤销案件 · 撤销账户. Also the Undo button in software.
Organization-level decision-making, mostly a noun: 做出决策 · 决策者 · 决策层 · 战略决策 · 科学决策. A personal choice is 决定.
Abstract route to a goal: 解决问题的途径 · 通过合法途径 · 传播途径 route of transmission. A physical road is 路/道路.
Written, mostly attributive: 贫困地区/人口/家庭 · 贫困生 needy student · 脱贫 · 扶贫 poverty relief. Calling a person poor in speech is 穷.
A person's caliber: 身体素质 fitness · 心理素质 composure · 综合素质 · 素质教育. Colloquial 没素质/素质低 = ill-mannered, not unintelligent.
Take someone to court: 起诉那家公司 · 被起诉 · 提起诉讼 · 起诉书 indictment. Appealing a verdict you lost is 上诉.
Hedges a predicate, 'counts as': 算是比较合理 · 算是我的朋友 · 勉强算是. With a finished event it means 'finally': 这下算是弄完了.
Verb-object, so it splits: 赚了不少钱 · 赚不到钱 · 赚大钱 · 赚钱的生意. 挣钱 leans on labor, 赚钱 on profit; largely interchangeable in speech.
At ease, unconstrained: 过得很自在 · 浑身不自在 ill at ease · 自由自在 carefree. 自由 is freedom as a right; 自在 is how it feels.
Institutional aid, noun or verb: 提供援助 · 国际/人道主义援助 · 经济援助 · 援助灾区. One person helping another is 帮助.
Implies bad or futile intent: 企图逃跑 · 企图自杀 · 企图掩盖真相. Also a noun: 不可告人的企图 ulterior motive. Neutral 'attempt' is 试图.
Regret over how things turned out, not over what you did (后悔): 感到遗憾 · 表示遗憾 (official register) · 终身遗憾 · 遗憾的是…
Two sides squaring off, roughly matched: 与…对抗 · 对抗赛 head-to-head · 对抗情绪 antagonism · 军事对抗. Resisting someone above you is 反抗.
Adj 'abnormal': 情况异常 · 数据异常 · 出现异常 (noun). Before an adj or verb it is a written intensifier = 非常: 异常激动 · 异常艰难.
After a list: 饺子、包子之类的食物 · 诸如…之类 · 说些客气话之类的. The neutral written alternative is 等等.
以…的名义 in the name of (以公司的名义签合同). And 名义上 nominally, usually set against 实际上: 名义上是经理，实际上没实权.
Noun/adj: 极端分子 extremist · 极端天气 · 手段太极端 · 走极端 go to extremes. Before an adjective it intensifies: 极端重要 · 极端困难.
Pushing back against power over you: 反抗父母/压迫/命运 · 奋起反抗 · 无力反抗 · 反抗精神. 对抗 is two roughly equal sides squaring off.
News and travel register: 抵达北京 · 航班已抵达 · 抵达现场. 到达 is the neutral formal word (到达时间); speech just says 到.
却 is an adverb: it goes after the subject and before the verb (他却是最努力的), never at the head like 但是. 却是 underlines the reversal.
Running into something bad, verb or noun: 遭遇车祸/挫折/不测 · 不幸的遭遇 a rough experience. 遭受 pairs with the harm itself (遭受损失).
Regulatory/collective term: 药品监管 · 药品说明书 · 处方药品 · 药品价格. The thing you swallow is 药 (吃药 · 买药).
Also a verb: 活跃气氛 liven up the mood · 活跃市场 stimulate the market · 活跃思想 stimulate thinking. Not just descriptive — it takes an object.
Object is an abstract state, usually bad: 陷入困境 trouble · 陷入僵局 deadlock · 陷入危机 · 陷入沉思 (neutral) · 陷入爱河 fall in love.
Literal rails/orbit (地铁轨道 · 进入轨道) plus figurative 'proper course': 走上正常轨道 · 纳入法制轨道 · 偏离轨道. Short form 正轨: 步入正轨.
Big city with atmosphere, mostly attributive: 都市生活 · 都市白领 · 都市情感剧 · 大都市 metropolis. The neutral administrative word is 城市.
An authority names the specific one: 指定地点/时间/医院 · 指定他负责 · 由公司指定. Attributive 指定商品/指定门店 = the designated ones.
Splitting into factions or cells: 细胞分裂 · 分裂国家 · 党内分裂 · 人格分裂. Dividing a physical thing up is 分开/切开.
News register for 最近: 近日气温下降 · 近日，我市…. It can also point forward — 近日将公布 in the coming days. Not casual speech.
Verb or noun, always tinged with 'unrealistic': 幻想自己是公主 · 别幻想了 · 幻想破灭 · 科幻 sci-fi. Neutral 'imagine' is 想象.
Housing as a category, formal: 住宅区 · 住宅楼 · 商品住宅 · 民用住宅. Your own place in speech is 家/房子.
Attributive 'not man-made': 天然气 gas · 天然资源 · 天然食品 · 纯天然. Rarely takes 很. 自然 is the broad word (大自然 · 自然一点 act natural).
The inner self, literary: 心灵深处 · 心灵的创伤 · 净化心灵 · 心灵鸡汤 feel-good platitudes. The organ is 心脏; everyday feeling just takes 心.
Letting out information meant to be held back — deliberately or by slip: 透露消息/内幕/细节 · 向记者透露 · 不愿透露姓名 · 透露说…
Elevated 'come into being': 新中国诞生 · 品牌诞生于… · 新技术诞生. Of people only in lofty tones (伟人诞生 · 诞辰); plain 'was born' is 出生.
A noun first: 成为主流 · 社会主流 · 非主流 alternative/edgy. Also attributive: 主流媒体 · 主流文化 · 主流价值观. Predicative 很主流 is casual.
Written adverb, straight before the verb: 一同前往 · 一同出席 · 与…一同. Unlike 一起 it is never a complement or predicate (住在一起 · 我们在一起).
The object is the harm itself: 遭受损失/打击/虐待/水灾 · 遭受重创. 受到 is the neutral one — 受到欢迎/表扬 works, 遭受 never takes good things.
Object is a right or a person's boundaries: 侵犯隐私/版权/权益/领空 · 性侵犯. Militarily invading a country is 侵略.
Written; opens a clause with the cutoff time, then a figure: 截至目前 · 截至去年底，已有…. 截止 is the verb — the activity ends (报名明天截止).
Reserved for one user or use: 专用车道 · 专用通道 · 儿童专用 · 军事专用. Predicative only via 是…的: 这条车道是公交车专用的. No 很.
The duties attached to a post: 履行职责 · 尽职尽责 · 职责范围 · 分内的职责. 责任 is wider — it covers blame too (承担责任).
Two senses: upper floors of a tall building (住在高层 · 高层住宅) and top brass (公司高层 · 高层领导 · 高层会晤 summit talks).
便 is the written 就: 便是 = 就是 · 说完便走 · 一…便… (天一亮便出发). Register is formal or literary, not speech.
Verb 'draw up': 编制预算/计划/教材. Missing from the gloss is the noun — an official staff quota: 有编制 · 事业编制 · 在编, i.e. a state-payroll post.
Two things blending into one: 中西融合 · 文化融合 · 融合了中西方风格 (transitive) · 相互融合. 融入 is one-way, fitting into a bigger whole.
Official/diplomatic: the senior party receives a visitor — 总统会见代表团 · 会见记者. Also legal: 律师会见当事人. Meeting a friend is 见面.
The civil defendant, paired with 原告 plaintiff: 起诉被告 · 被告方 · 被告律师. In criminal cases the word is 被告人. Courtroom use only.
Verb-object: 留个言 · 给我留言 · 在评论区留言 (the person takes 给, not a direct object). Also a noun: 一条留言 · 留言板 · 看留言.
Marketing register for building something up: 打造品牌 · 打造平台 · 打造精品 · 倾力打造. The literal sense is forging metal (打造首饰).
Figurative as often as literal: 金融风暴 · 舆论风暴 · 头脑风暴 brainstorming · 风暴中心. Actual bad weather is usually 暴风雨/台风.
Two readings: zhèngdàng 'legitimate' — 正当途径/理由/权益 · 正当防卫 self-defense; zhèngdāng 'just when' — 正当他要走的时候 · 正当此时.
Predicative (记忆力惊人) and attributive (惊人的速度), but the pattern worth drilling is the complement after 得: 贵得惊人 · 快得惊人 · 准得惊人.
Attributive, on a fixed set of nouns: 高等教育 · 高等院校 · 高等数学 · 高等动物. Not a general word for tall or high (楼很高).
X面向Y = X is aimed at Y: 面向年轻读者 · 面向全国招生 · 面向市场 · 面向未来. Institutional register; physical facing exists too (房间面向大海).
Formal; the object is something abstract you had: 丧失信心/记忆/能力/资格 · 丧失劳动能力. A lost wallet is 丢/丢失.
Two words in one: adverb 'together' before the verb (一道去看电影 · 与…一道), and the measure word — 一道菜 · 一道题 · 一道光 · 一道疤.
An institution issues something to many people: 发放工资/补贴/贷款/证书 · 发放物资 · 现场发放. Person-to-person giving is 给/发 (发红包).
要么…要么… sets out mutually exclusive options (要么你去，要么我去). A single 要么 floats a suggestion: 要么明天再说? 或者 merely lists.
The media as an industry: 传媒行业/公司/集团 · 大众传媒 · 传媒大学. Outlets and 'the press' in news copy are 媒体 (媒体报道).
Always unwelcome meddling: 干涉内政 · 干涉别人的私事 · 横加干涉 · 互不干涉. Neutral or legitimate intervention is 干预 (政府干预市场).
A physical passage: 安全通道 fire exit · 人行通道 · 生命通道 · 绿色通道 fast track. A channel for goods or information is 渠道.
Medical: 心脏病 · 心脏手术 · 心脏骤停. Figurative only for a central place: 城市的心脏 · 心脏地带 heartland. Feelings take 心/心灵.
Now mostly abstract: 销售渠道 · 融资渠道 · 通过正规渠道 · 拓宽渠道. The literal sense is an irrigation channel; a walkway is 通道.
Used of the UK's and Japan's PM (英国首相 · 日本首相). Most other premiers are 总理 (德国总理 · 国务院总理); a head of state is 总统.
Sentence-final, pairs with 只是/不过 to deflate what precedes: 我只是随便问问罢了 · 不过是个玩笑罢了. The spoken equivalent is …而已.
Holding off an attacking force: 抵抗侵略 · 顽强抵抗 · 无力抵抗 · 抵抗力 immunity (its most everyday use). 反抗 is rebelling; 抵制 is boycotting.
Verb-object: 罢了三天工 and 罢工了三天 are both normal · 举行罢工 stage a strike · 大罢工. Jokey for gear giving out: 空调罢工了.
Read gōngjǐ (给 as jǐ). Economics register: 供给与需求 · 供给侧改革 · 供给不足. Everyday supplying is 供应 (供应商 · 供应链).
Works both ways: 政府出台新政策 · 新规即将出台. The object is always a policy or rule — 政策 · 措施 · 办法 · 细则. A product launching is 上市.
Clipped from 科学研究; used as a modifier or an object: 科研人员/经费/项目/成果 · 搞科研 · 从事科研工作. Researching something is 研究.
Overlook — leave out of account: 忽略细节 · 忽略不计 negligible · 容易被忽略. 忽视 leans toward neglecting what deserves attention (忽视安全).
Two lives: collecting valuables (收藏品 · 收藏家 · 值得收藏) and the app Save/Bookmark button (收藏这条视频 · 收藏夹).
Attributive only: 沿海地区/城市/省份 · 东南沿海. No 很, no predicate use. Same shape: 沿江 · 沿线 · 沿途.
Attributive by default, meaning the classical canon: 古典音乐/文学/舞蹈/园林. Of a person's looks 很古典 does occur. Ancient = 古老, a classic = 经典.
Intransitive — the activity itself ends: 报名明天截止 · 到月底截止 · 截止日期/时间 deadline. 截至 is the written preposition (截至目前，已有…).
Attributive only: 新兴行业/产业/市场/国家 · 新兴技术. Describes a sector on the rise; not used as a predicate.
Disaster-response register: 救援队/人员/物资 · 展开救援 · 紧急救援 · 救援行动. Ordinary helping is 帮助; pulling one person out is 救.
Head of an association or society: 协会会长 · 商会会长 · 校友会会长 · 名誉会长. A company's chair is 董事长, a school's head 校长.
Being alone as a condition — it can ache (感到孤独) or be embraced (享受孤独 · 孤独感). 寂寞 is the restless want of company, always unwelcome.
Formal: 保持清洁 keep clean · 清洁工 cleaner · 清洁能源 clean energy · 清洁剂. Also a verb (清洁皮肤). Judging a thing clean in speech is 干净.
Medical/technical register: 血液循环 · 血液检查 · 血液病. Figurative 注入新鲜血液 bring in new blood. Bleeding and blood itself take 血 (流血).
yìxíng, right after a name or title = that person plus their party: 总经理一行 · 代表团一行五人. News register. Read yī háng it means 'one line'.
Chief, prefixed to a title: 首席执行官 CEO · 首席技术官 · 首席科学家 · 首席小提琴 concertmaster. Doesn't stand alone as a noun.
Either after the event (这件事过后…) or alone meaning 'later on': 过后我再告诉你 · 过后就忘了. Implies time has since passed; 之后 is neutral.
Trending topic: 网络热点 · 热点新闻 · 热点话题 · 蹭热点 chase a trend. Also the phone's WiFi hotspot: 开热点 · 热点共享.
Paperwork register — altering what was formally set: 合同变更 · 变更地址/名称 · 行程变更 · 变更手续. Everyday changing is 改变/改.
Beyond the glass: a service counter (售票窗口 · 挂号窗口), a computer window (弹出窗口 pop-up), and a period of opportunity (窗口期).
Instrument tracking of measurable things: 监测水质/空气/血压/疫情 · 实时监测 · 监测数据. Watching a suspect is 监视; camera surveillance 监控.
Productive suffix: 国内外 at home and abroad · 校内外 · 党内外 · 里里外外 · 内外交困. After a number it means 'about' (三十岁内外), though 左右 is usual.
Official register — the listener takes in input from below: 听取汇报/意见/建议/呼声 · 广泛听取. The object is always speech, never music.
Using up a finite resource: 消耗体力/能量/资源 · 消耗量 · 消耗战 war of attrition. Spending money as a consumer is 消费.
Industry word for a performer: 旗下艺人 · 艺人经纪 · 偶像艺人. Older sense 民间艺人 folk performer. A painter or sculptor is 艺术家.
One-way — X blends into the bigger Y: 融入社会/集体/新环境 · 难以融入. Also 'work into': 把传统元素融入设计. Mutual merging is 融合.
Written, and often a noun: 令人担忧 worrying · 深感担忧 · 表示担忧 · 引发担忧. Speech says 担心 (我担心你).
Reputation in the public or legal sense: 损害名誉 · 名誉权 · 名誉扫地 disgraced. Also 'honorary' before a title: 名誉主席 · 名誉博士.
Literal: 话剧下周上演 · 上演新片. Figurative and common: 悲剧再次上演 · 上演了一场闹剧 — events playing out as if scripted.
The figurative sense is the common one: 心理阴影 · 留下阴影 · 走出阴影 put it behind you · 笼罩在…的阴影下. Also medical: 肺部有阴影.
Official adverb before a verb, 'actually deliver': 切实解决/加强/保障 · 切实履行职责. Also an adjective in 切实可行 practicable · 切实有效.
Performing on an instrument: 演奏钢琴/小提琴 · 演奏一首曲子 · 演奏家 · 现场演奏. Casually you 弹钢琴/拉小提琴; singing is 唱, acting 表演.
tóngháng, someone in your line of work: 我们是同行 · 同行竞争 · 同行评议 peer review. The same characters read tóngxíng are 'travel together'.
Breaking new ground: 开创先河 · 开创新局面 · 开创新纪元 · 开创性 groundbreaking. Founding an actual company or school is 创办/创立.
Adverbial before the verb, 地 optional: 深深地影响 · 深深爱着 · 深深吸了一口气 · 深深鞠了一躬. About feeling and impression, not physical depth.
An unchanging habit or stance across instances: 一贯准时 · 一贯主张 · 一贯的作风/立场 · 一贯如此. 一直 is unbroken duration up to now.
Picking the best out of a pool by testing: 选拔人才/运动员 · 选拔赛 tryout · 层层选拔. 选择 is choosing between options; 选举 is voting.
Three uses: predicate 'won't do' (这样不成), potential complement (去不成 can't make it), and sentence-final with 难道…不成? for 'surely not'.
Lives in institutional compounds: 工商局 · 工商银行 (ICBC) · 工商登记 · 工商管理 business administration (MBA = 工商管理硕士).
After a verb = a good round of it: 考虑一番 · 打扮一番 · 教训一番 a talking-to (more effort than 一下). Before nouns: 一番话 · 一番好意 · 另一番景象.
Stats: 与去年同期相比 · 同期增长/下降 (clipped form 同比). Also 'the same run/cohort': 同期上映 · 同期毕业生. Plain 'at the same time' is 同时.
Formal 'seize by force' — abstract/prize objects: 夺取政权 seize power · 夺取冠军 clinch the title · 夺取胜利. More literary than 抢 or 拿.
Fame traced to a cause: 因…而出名 · 以…出名 · 一夜出名 · 很出名. The plain state of being famous is 有名/知名.
Moral evil as a mass noun: 罪恶感 guilt · 罪恶的行为 · 充满罪恶 · 罪恶滔天. A specific offense is 罪行; committing a crime is 犯罪.
凡是 heads a noun or clause and is closed by 都/就: 凡是他说的我都信 · 凡是十八岁以下的都不能开车. The 都 is what makes it universal.
Attributive mostly: 应急预案 contingency plan · 应急措施/通道/灯 · 应急工具箱. As a verb it means tide over a pinch: 先拿这些钱应应急.
The danger is the direct object: 防范风险/诈骗/扒手 · 加强防范 · 防范意识. The set phrase is 防患于未然 (患, not 范) — head trouble off early.
Keeping healthy rather than treating illness (治疗): 注重保健 · 保健品 supplements · 保健操 · 保健医生 · 医疗保健.
Official aid to people in distress: 救助被困者 · 社会救助 relief · 救助站 shelter · 救助流浪动物. Ordinary helping is 帮助.
Written 'at every moment': 时时记挂 · 时时提醒自己 · 时时刻刻. Bookish on its own — speech prefers 常常/老是/随时.
Read bùjīn. Written adverb before the verb, for an involuntary reaction: 不禁笑了起来 · 不禁想起 · 不禁流下眼泪. Speech uses 忍不住.
Collective noun for shipping in general: 各类船只 · 过往船只 · 船只失联. Not counted individually — one boat is 一艘船.
Formal 'to charge/collect' — takes fees as object: 收取费用/手续费/利息. More official-sounding than plain 收.
Your own master in a craft, an art, or religion: 拜师父 · 师父领进门. The homophone 师傅 is how you address any skilled worker (师傅，到火车站).
好容易 = 好不容易, 'only with great difficulty' — the 不 changes nothing: 好容易等到周末 · 好不容易才买到. Usually followed by 才 or a letdown.
Takes the stake as object: 赌钱 · 赌一把 take the gamble · 我跟你赌. Betting with someone is 打赌; the stake is 赌注. The vice itself is 赌博.
The activity or vice itself: 沉迷赌博 · 参与赌博 · 赌博网站 · 禁止赌博. Figurative: 这是一场赌博. A specific stake takes bare 赌 (赌钱).
Whether something lasts: 长久以来 all along · 长久之计 a lasting solution · 不能长久 won't last · 天长地久. 长期 is a neutral span (长期合作); 长远 is forward-looking.
Subject greets an arrival — people or a new period alike: 迎来一批新生 · 迎来新时代/旅游旺季 · 迎来送往. Written-leaning; the plain act of welcoming sb is 欢迎.
Dominance and leverage, not bodily strength (强壮): 性格强势 · 强势货币 strong currency · 强势回归 storm back · 处于强势地位.
After the fact, in hindsight: 事后才发现 · 事后处理 · 事后诸葛亮 hindsight expert. Pairs with 事前/事先. Not a general 'later' — that's 以后.
Formal, and unlike V+O 唱歌 it takes an object of praise: 歌唱祖国 · 歌唱家 vocalist · 歌唱比赛. Everyday singing is 唱歌.
Assess against a yardstick: 用成绩衡量 · 衡量标准 criterion · 衡量利弊 weigh pros and cons. Abstract only — physical weighing is 称.
Pairs with abstract limits: 超出预算/范围/预期/想象. Contrast 超过, the general word for exceeding a quantity or another thing (超过一半, 超过他).
Formal/legal word for relatives — 直系亲属 'immediate family' in official contexts. Everyday speech uses 亲戚.
Regional colloquial for 知道 — everyday in Taiwan and in southwestern and Wu areas (四川, 上海). Commonest negated: 不晓得 dunno · 谁晓得. Northern speech says 知道.
Can be intransitive (subject itself mobilizes: 警察出动了) or transitive (出动+what's dispatched: 出动了大批警力). Both directions are common.
Step in personally, lending your name or authority: 由经理出面 · 亲自出面 · 出面调解/交涉. Followed by a verb, never a noun object.
Colloquial and gradable: 太惨了 · 惨了! uh-oh · 输得很惨 lose badly · 死得很惨. 悲惨 is the written adjective for a tragic life.
Written and serious, of a life or fate: 悲惨的命运/生活/遭遇 · 悲惨世界 Les Misérables. The spoken 'that's awful' is bare 惨: 太惨了.
Takes tension/conflict as object — 化解矛盾/危机/尴尬 'defuse, dissolve'. Contrast 解决, the general word for solving a problem outright.
Passage sense: 禁止通行 no through traffic · 通行证 pass · 通行费 toll. Separate sense 'in general use': 通行的做法/规则 · 全国通行.
Fitting, hits the mark — of wording, measures, timing: 恰当的词/比喻 · 用词不恰当 · 处理得很恰当. 合适 is the everyday 'suits me' word.
kànhǎo = be bullish on, tip to win: 看好这家公司 · 不被看好 the underdog · 我看好你. Different word: kānhǎo 看好孩子/门 'keep an eye on'.
Literal coming and going (自由出入 · 出入证 entry pass) plus 'discrepancy': 有出入 · 与事实出入很大 — the second is common in reports.
Transitive: you swap something for another form — 变换位置/角度/发型/花样. 变化 is intransitive and also a noun: 天气变化了 · 发生了变化.
Written register — notices, forecasts, headlines (明日多云); speech says 明天. Set phrases: 明日之星 rising star · 明日黄花 yesterday's news.
Two uses: quantity 'most of' (多半人反对) and, before a verb, the guess 'probably': 多半要下雨 · 他多半是忘了.
Forward-looking/strategic — 从长远看, 长远规划/利益. Distinguish from 长久 (enduring over time) and 长期 (neutral long-term duration).
Plural subject, or A与/和B, then a verb: 两家公司联手开发 · 与…联手 · 联手打击/推出. Implies a strategic alliance; plain teamwork is 合作.
Intransitive and formal: 经济复苏 · 市场逐渐复苏 · 万物复苏 (spring) · 心肺复苏 CPR. 恢复 is the one that takes an object (恢复健康).
Recycled/renewable, attributively: 再生纸/再生材料/再生能源/再生资源. As a verb it is biological regeneration: 细胞再生 · 再生能力.
Literary 'reason/cause', typically in 因为…的缘故 or 不知什么缘故 'for some reason'. More bookish than plain 原因.
Draw on someone else's experience and apply it yourself: 借鉴经验/做法/模式 · 值得借鉴 worth emulating · 相互借鉴. 参考 is merely consulting.
跟…来往 keep in touch, socialize · 没有来往 out of contact · 来往的车辆 passing traffic. 往来 is the formal twin: 贸易往来 · 书信往来.
Object is always a proposal, opinion or plan: 采纳建议/意见/方案; the subject is whoever decides. Accepting a gift, apology or person is 接受.
'By lucky coincidence, just right' about timing/quantity: 恰好赶上. Contrast 恰恰 (stresses an exact match between two facts) and 恰当 'appropriate'.
Written 'be widespread' — of practices, styles, ideas: 在年轻人中盛行 · 盛行一时 have a vogue · 一度盛行. Everyday 'popular' is 流行.
Written prediction, before a verb: 必将成功 · 必将载入史册 · 历史必将证明…. Speech and neutral writing use 一定会.
Emphatic 'precisely', typically against expectation: 恰恰相反 quite the opposite · 恰恰是他 · 恰恰说明了…. 恰好 is lucky timing; 恰当 is 'appropriate'.
Adverb before a verb describing strict sequence: 依次排队/介绍. Contrast 陆续 'one after another' with gaps, not necessarily in fixed order.
Adverb: 用心学习/做事 · 很用心 · 用心良苦 went to great pains. As a noun it means motive: 别有用心 have ulterior motives.
An official campaign against a problem: 整治环境/交通秩序/河道 · 专项整治. 治理 is broader long-term management. Colloquially 整治人 = teach sb a lesson.
Describes abstract solidity — skills, foundation, work (基本功扎实). For a physically sturdy object (rope, furniture), use 结实 instead.
Mostly a noun: 老搭档 longtime partner · 最佳搭档 · 找个搭档. As a verb it needs a partner and usually a task: 跟他搭档 · 两人搭档主持.
Take in and raise permanently: 收养孤儿/流浪狗 · 收养关系 (legal). 收留 is only temporary shelter; 领养 is the everyday word for adopting.
分工明确 clear division of roles · 分工合作 · 社会分工 division of labour. Separable verb too: 我们分一下工 · 分好工再动手.
打发时间/日子 kill time · 打发他走 send him packing · 好打发 easy to satisfy. With a person as object it is dismissive.
Upmarket, of goods and venues: 高档汽车/餐厅/小区 · 高档货. Predicative too: 装修很高档. Opposite 低档; 高级 is broader ('advanced, senior').
特意 + verb: 特意为你准备 · 特意跑一趟 · 特意提前出门. Interchangeable with 特地. Not 故意, which implies you meant harm.
V+不通 potential complement: 想不通 can't get my head round it · 说不通 doesn't add up · 行不通 won't work · 电话打不通. Alone: 逻辑不通 incoherent.
The target sits between 指着 and the main verb: 指着黑板讲 · 指着我的鼻子骂. Colloquial figurative: 就指着这份工作过日子 counting on it.
Noun — needs a verb: 打官司 go to court · 打赢官司 win a case · 惹上官司 get sued · 一场官司. Colloquial; the formal term is 诉讼.
Mostly a noun: 政治觉悟 · 觉悟高 · 提高觉悟. As a verb, a deep moral awakening (觉悟到…) — everyday 'realize' is 意识到/发现.
Legal term; its counterpart is 被告 'defendant/the accused'.
不怎么 + V/adj = 'not really': 不怎么喜欢 · 不怎么来了 · 不怎么好. Understated, softer than 不太. Standalone 不怎么样 = 'nothing special'.
Everyday 'auspicious', about numbers, dates, colours — most often negated: 不吉利 · 图个吉利 for luck · 吉利数字. 吉祥 is the ceremonial twin.
Formal: 陪同 + person + verb (陪同领导访问) · 在…的陪同下 accompanied by · 陪同人员 escort. Everyday 'come with you' is plain 陪 (陪你去).
Value added or gained: 增值税 VAT · 增值服务 value-added services · 保值增值 preserve and grow. For an asset's price rising, 升值 is the usual word.
The department you register at: 挂外科 · 外科医生 surgeon · 脑外科/骨科. Counterpart 内科 internal medicine; the operation itself is 手术.
Nurturing, protective care, often for a vulnerable group (关爱老人/儿童) — more formal/PSA-register than everyday 关心 'be concerned about'.
眼看(着)就要…了 = any moment now (天眼看就要黑了) — pure imminence. 眼看着 + event can carry 'and could only watch', but that comes from context.
Concessive: despite X, still — 下雨天照样骑车 · 照样能过日子. Second use, 'following the model': 照样造句 make a sentence on this pattern.
特地 + verb of coming/doing: 特地跑来看你 · 特地为你做的. Same as 特意, slightly more spoken. Not 故意, which implies deliberate wrongdoing.
Ceremonial and symbolic: 吉祥物 mascot · 吉祥如意 (New Year greeting) · 吉祥话 auspicious phrases. 吉利 is the everyday one (不吉利).
Rejects an over-the-top consequence: 不至于被开除吧 · 还不至于那么糟 · standalone 不至于吧! 'come on, surely not'. Usually with 吧 or 那么.
'免得+clause' = 'so as to avoid X' in the second clause: 带把伞，免得淋湿. More colloquial than the written equivalent 以免.
Two uses: temporal at the head of a clause, 'from now on' (往后你要多注意), and directional with a motion verb, 往后退/靠/看. Position tells you which.
= 只好/不得不 'have no choice but to' — more written register, always precedes the forced action: 只得走路回家.
Something moves a person: 打动了她 · 打动人心 · 深深打动了我. Needs an agent as subject; 感动 works both ways (我很感动 / 故事感动了大家).
Official/news term, short for 人民警察, for an individual officer: 民警提醒市民… · 社区民警 · 值班民警. In speech you say 警察; you address one as 警官.
Despite the 不, means the same as 好容易 — 'finally managed after a lot of effort,' not 'not easy.' Pattern: 好不容易才 + V, describing something hard-won.
掉 = the thing ends up gone: 去掉/扔掉/擦掉/删掉/忘掉. Object follows the pair: 去掉辣椒. Potential forms 去得掉 / 去不掉.
Always disparaging — manufactured buzz: 媒体炒作 · 恶意炒作 · 自我炒作 self-promotion · 炒作概念/话题. Neutral promotion is 宣传/推广.
Critical: absorbed in one thing and neglecting the rest — 只顾着玩手机 · 只顾自己 · 不能只顾眼前. Often 只顾着+V. 只管 is the permissive twin.
Topic-comment, no 的: 我头疼 'I have a headache'. Figurative: 让人头疼 a real headache · 头疼的问题. 头痛 is the same word, more written.
给 + person + 让座: 给老人让座. 座 is the object, so it can split: 让个座、让了座。
Also the ♣ clubs suit in playing cards (with 红心 hearts, 黑桃 spades, 方块 diamonds), not just the flower.
News register for the scale of an incident: 特大事故/暴雨/火灾/案件 (an official severity grade). Also sizes: 特大号 XL. Everyday 'huge' is 特别大.
Sports foul: 恶意犯规 · 技术犯规 · 犯规被罚下. Already V+O and separable: 犯了两次规. Breaking a law is 犯法/违法; a regulation, 违规.
For roads/traffic/communication flowing freely: 保持电话畅通 (keep the line open) · 交通畅通 · 畅通无阻 (idiom, unobstructed).
(formal) direct address to a group, like 各位 — used when speaking TO people, not to talk about them.
Colloquial 外面, northern-flavoured: 在外头等 · 外头冷. Same 头 family: 里头 · 上头 · 后头 · 前头.
Two different words by tone: bēizhe = carrying on your back (背着书包); bèizhe = reciting from memory, or 'behind someone's back' (背着他做 = without him knowing).
Somewhat informal/dated and can sound condescending; the neutral official term is 农民工。
-星 suffix = 'star' in a field, productive: 歌星 singing star, 影星 movie star, 明星 celebrity generally.
Extra tuition outside class: 补习英语 · 补习班 cram school · 课外补习. 补课 is making up teaching time; 补考 is a resit exam.
Often paired 表面上...，实际上... (on the surface... but actually...) — signals appearance vs. reality.
V+O already: 救他的命 or 救他, never 救命他. Shouted alone = Help! Attributive: 救命恩人 the one who saved you · 救命稻草 straw to clutch at.
Two senses: steady and down-to-earth (踏踏实实地工作 · 做人踏实) and feeling settled (心里踏实 · 睡得踏实). Read tāshi.
Taiwan/southern usage for AC: 开冷气 · 吹冷气 · 冷气房. Mainland standard is 空调, where 冷气 means the cold air itself.
Permissive 'just go ahead, leave the rest to me': 你只管去 · 有事只管说 · 只管放心. Like 尽管 here. 只顾 is the critical twin.
(written) introduces a surprising turn after stating what was expected: 我以为...，不料... — like 没想到 but more literary.
Traffic-law term: 机动车道 vehicle lane · 机动车驾驶证 licence · 禁止机动车通行. Counterpart 非机动车 (bikes, e-bikes). In speech you just say 车.
Covers all drinks served at a meal/banquet, alcoholic and soft — not just alcohol despite 酒. Menu term: 酒水单。
Queen consort, the king's wife — a queen who reigns is 女王 (伊丽莎白女王). The chess queen is also 王后.
Also figurative: 披着...的外衣 = 'disguised as / wearing the guise of' (e.g. 披着合法的外衣, posing as legitimate).
V+O: 给他治病 · 治好了病 · 治不好. The doctor 治病, the patient 看病 (看医生). Set phrase 治病救人.
For currency/assets appreciating over time (房子升值、人民币升值) — contrast 涨价, a plain price increase on goods.
Written, of scale and ambition: 规模宏大 · 宏大的目标/场面 · 宏大叙事 grand narrative. Everyday bigness is 大/巨大.
遍地(都)是 + noun: 遍地都是野花. Also straight before a noun: 遍地黄金 · 遍地开花 spring up everywhere.
Beyond literal length, appears in set phrases: 三长两短 (euphemism for a fatal accident) and 说长道短 (to gossip).
(written) poetic word for 'season/time' — 清明时节, 春暖花开时节. Not used for casual clock-time.
对…忠心 be loyal to (对主人忠心) · 一片忠心 · 忠心耿耿 loyal to the core. For people's loyalty the usual modern word is 忠诚.
Formal — speeches, letters, toasts: 祝愿你们幸福 · 衷心祝愿. Also a noun: 送上美好的祝愿. Everyday well-wishing is plain 祝 (祝你生日快乐).
Also figurative: (stocks/prices) to nosedive/crash — 股价跳水了 = the stock price plummeted.
Potential complement (用+得/不+着): 用得着 = have a use for it; 用不着 = no need for it. Common in rhetorical questions: 这用得着你操心吗?
Potential complement, V+得/不+见: 看得见 = able to see it, 看不见 = can't. Different from 看见 (did see, a completed event).
(literary) usually 无边无际 (boundless, idiom) or as a poetic modifier: 无边的草原。
Fixed phrase 名胜古迹 scenic spots and historic sites · 风景名胜区 (official designation). Rarely alone in speech — a single site is 景点.
(literary) = 好像/似乎 — more poetic/written register, not used in casual speech.
Fixed letter-closing formula: 此致 on its own line, then 敬礼 on the next — like 'Sincerely,' formatting. Only in formal written letters.
泼冷水 pour cold water on sb's enthusiasm · 冷水澡 cold shower · 冷水下锅 (start in cold water). For drinking water, speech prefers 凉水.
News/medical register: 抢救伤员 · 转移伤员 · 重伤员. -员 = person in a role (队员, 学员). Everyday you'd say 伤者 or 受伤的人.
Also figurative: 有墨水/肚子里有墨水 = to be well-read/educated ('have ink in your belly').
Medical-leaning: 食欲不振 poor appetite · 没有食欲 · 影响/增进食欲. Colloquial 胃口 covers the same ground and extends to appetite for anything.
Institutional register: 少儿频道 · 少儿读物 · 少儿不宜 not suitable for children. In speech: 小孩/孩子.
Common collocations: 升学率 (rate of advancing to the next school level) · 升学压力 (pressure to get into the next school).
Contrast 一起 (together, spatial/accompaniment): 一齐 means 'simultaneously, in unison' (temporal) — 一齐鼓掌 = everyone clapped at the same instant.
Also what you say when taking a photo — 说'茄子'! is the Chinese equivalent of 'say cheese!'
Both a noun and a form of address: 老乡，帮个忙 · 他是我老乡 · 遇到老乡. Warm, hometown/migrant flavour; the neutral word is 同乡.
Spend less, not put aside — 存钱 is banking it. Splits: 省了不少钱 · 能省则省. Also predicative: 自己做饭很省钱.
-迷 suffix = 'fan of X,' productive: 球迷 sports fan, 歌迷 fan of a singer.
Banking register: 自动取款机 ATM · 取款密码 PIN · 存款和取款. In speech: 取钱.
Written — a visible outburst rather than the feeling: 他发怒了 · 惹他发怒. The feeling is 生气; the colloquial blow-up is 发火.
(literary), for sunlight/grand light shining on something — 阳光照耀着大地. Everyday equivalent: 照 or 照射。
Often figurative for looming trouble: 乌云密布 (idiom) — dark clouds gathering, an ominous sign.
Counterpart 笔试 written exam — both are school or certification exams. A job interview is 面试, never 口试.
Two readings: āi = next to/in sequence (挨着坐 sit side by side, 一个挨一个 one by one); ái = to endure something bad (挨打 get beaten, 挨骂 get scolded).
ái + a bad thing you are on the receiving end of: 挨打 · 挨骂 · 挨批评 · 挨饿 go hungry. Subject is the victim, no 被 needed: 他挨了一顿打.
(literary) = 看见/看到 but for spotting something from a distance; 见 is the resultative complement, so 望不见 = can't spot it from here.
Colloquial 小时, and it always needs 个: 一个钟头, 半个钟头 (小时 can drop it: 两小时). Not used in schedules or formal writing.
Industry/category term — 音像店 audio & video store, 音像制品 audiovisual media/recordings.
Potential complement (看+得/不+起) — the negative 看不起 ('look down on someone') is the far more commonly used, salient form.
Making up teaching time: 给他补课 · 补了两节课 (separable) · 周末补课 extra weekend classes. 补习 is outside tutoring, 补考 a resit exam.
Attributive, paired against 高等: 初等数学 vs 高等数学 · 初等教育 primary schooling. 'Beginner-level' in general is 初级 (初级班).
Colloquial, for adults and elders: 多大岁数了 · 上了岁数 getting on in years · 岁数大了. Kids get 几岁; forms and records use 年龄.
跟/和…打官司 · 打赢了官司 · 打了三年官司. Colloquial; the legal terms are 起诉 to sue and 诉讼 litigation.

Specific/operational tactics — contrast 战略 (zhànlüè), the overall strategy. Collocates with 制定/使用战术 (devise/use tactics).
Running a business: 经营一家书店 · 经营范围 · 经营不善 mismanagement. Contrast 管理 general administration. Figurative: 经营感情/婚姻.

Predicate or exclamation: 你太过分了! that's out of line. Also adverbial 'excessively': 过分强调 · 不要过分担心 · 过分依赖.
掌握/行使权力 hold, exercise power · 滥用权力 abuse · 权力斗争 power struggle. Homophone: 权利 quánlì = rights (合法权利) — different word.
Polysemous: after a number = 'approximately' (三点左右); as a verb = 'to control/influence' (你不要左右我的决定).
Abstract resultative uses beyond literal descent: 安静下来 (calm down), 记录下来 (write down), 坚持下来 (make it through, persist).
